Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

Title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/x)
Description:
Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.



Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.



Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.



Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).





Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget
Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes
Opportunity to work from abroad
Benefit from an attractive compensation package and from the company pension scheme
Monthly contribution of 50% for the ‘Deutschland Jobticket’
Say goodbye to order commissions and say hello to your complimentary subscription of Scalable Capital's PRIME+ Broker
Enjoy flexible and discounted sports activities with Urban Sports Club

Description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a leading Berlin-based productivity software scale-up.

The Role

Job Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark

Location: Berlin, Germany

Why this role matters

Our email client is scaling fast, and we need to move from tracking data to aggressively predicting and validating what drives growth. Without this role, our product and marketing teams cannot rapidly iterate, run quasi-experiments, or build the deep causal inference models needed to unlock our next stage of subscription revenue. You will be the critical engine that turns raw user touchpoints into strategic, high-impact product decisions.

What You'll Do

You will own the entire growth loop analytics for our email client, ensuring every stage from first ad impression to long-term subscription renewal is fully measurable.


Design robust event tracking structures and instrumentation to ensure flawless measurement across the entire user journey.
Build and maintain growth dashboards in Tableau or Looker that make acquisition and retention performance crystal clear for cross-functional teams.
Uncover growth opportunities by digging deep into funnels, user cohorts, and subscription metrics like churn and LTV.
Design and execute A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal inference models to validate marketing and product hypotheses.
Deploy advanced forecasting models using Python or R to predict long-term subscription dynamics and trend lines.


What success looks like

Month 1: You will deeply integrate with the product and marketing teams, audit our current data pipelines in BigQuery and tracking setups in Amplitude and AppsFlyer, and identify immediate tracking improvements.

Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of our growth dashboards, design and launch your first batch of A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and establish a standardized methodology for measuring marketing attribution.

By end of Q1: You will have built a reliable, end-to-end subscription analytics framework that clearly connects first-click marketing attribution to long-term cohort retention, enabling swift, data-backed product decisions.

Who This Is a Fit For


Have 5+ years of analytics experience in B2C mobile apps or subscription SaaS.
Expert-level SQL wizard with hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
Fluent in visualization and product analytics tools like Tableau, Looker, and Amplitude.
Experienced with mobile marketing attribution mechanics using platforms like AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Proficient in Python or R for time-series forecasting and causal inference.
Thrive on high autonomy, taking full personal responsibility for product outcomes.


What it's like to work here

The company's culture is rooted in deep customer-centricity and continuous professional growth, with a massive emphasis on individual autonomy and ownership. Team members are expected to drive their own initiatives and take full responsibility for product outcomes. Decision-making is highly collaborative yet swift, heavily guided by data analysis, rapid iteration, and continuous experimentation to validate product hypotheses. This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing, demanding a proactive builder who thrives on fast feedback loops and constant adaptation.

The offer


Work in our Berlin office within a culture that prioritizes your professional growth.
Massive autonomy to drive your own initiatives and experiments.
A highly collaborative environment that values data-backed, swift decision-making.


This probably isn't for you if


You prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned rather than proactively finding growth opportunities.
You struggle to make decisions without absolute certainty or dislike rapid, constant iteration.
You want a pure modeling role without getting your hands dirty with event-tracking design.

Title: Senior Business Analyst (all genders) - Lounge by Zalando - Parental Leave Cover (12 months)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

As a Senior Business Analyst in our Supply Analytics team at Zalando Lounge, you will work alongside the Supply team and leadership toward our vision of acquiring unmatched value-for-money deals that drive Lounge user acquisition, conversion, and retention.

In this role, you will build on your analytical and statistical skills to generate actionable business insights that enable smarter decision-making. You will lead and implement initiatives to develop sustainable reporting solutions and create fact-based insights regarding our partner (supplier) lifecycle and pricing dynamics, from both quantity and quality perspectives. You will actively collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders by sharing relevant context based on the key performance indicators (KPIs) you track, analyze, and embed across the business. To succeed in this role, you should possess a naturally analytical mindset and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

About Lounge By Zalando

Lounge by Zalando is an online outlet for fashion and lifestyle products in 25 European countries.

We offer our members daily, time-limited sale campaigns with discounts of up to 75% off the recommended retail price.

However, Lounge by Zalando is so much more than discounts. Our strength lies in our focus on fashion: from sought-after labels to niche brands, from famous international names to trendy luxury brands, we make sure to meet the fashion taste of all our customers, who are always on the hunt for the best products at the best prices.

Working with our brand partners, we're pioneering innovative supply-chain and production processes and offer them an impactful and smart solution, creating a new way to shop for fashion - and a new way to sell it.

Our motto: Not your average outlet.

https://www.zalando-lounge.de

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Operationalize Business Reporting: Develop a deep understanding of our business processes, tools, and overall data landscape to build, implement, and operationalize reporting focused on Partner insights and Pricing capabilities for Zalando Lounge (connecting inventory, sales, supply, planning, and steering).
Drive Analytical Insights: Formulate and test hypotheses using descriptive, exploratory, and quantitative analyses to generate impactful business insights while identifying emerging risks and strategic opportunities.
Engage Senior Stakeholders: Present complex analytical findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders in a visually compelling, easily digestible manner (using Tableau or Databricks) to advance our collective intelligence.
Deliver End-to-End Analytics: Take full accountability for all stages of data analysis, research, and data visualization using narrative storytelling, while leading high-impact Data & Analytics projects and initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with technology and data teams across Zalando to maximize the utility of existing datasets and ensure optimal access to high-value data points.


WE'D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


Technical Expertise: You are a highly proficient user of Tableau and Databricks, with strong SQL skills (Python is a plus). You work autonomously with these tools and can effectively guide others in using them.
Proven Impact & Domain Knowledge: You have led initiatives or projects that enabled businesses to make high-impact decisions through your insights or developed solutions. Domain expertise in inventory management or the planning and steering of sales and supply is a strong plus.
Education & Experience: You hold a degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a similar quantitative field, paired with 5+ years of professional experience in a similar role (ideally in a fast-paced e-commerce or retail environment). Knowledge of statistical methods is a plus.
Mindset & Adaptability: Collaborators value your drive to make an impact, your ability to spot inefficiencies with a hands-on approach, and your knack for finding simple, efficient solutions to complex challenges. You are proactive and adapt quickly to change while remaining focused on key objectives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: You balance technical acumen with business understanding, excelling at collaborating with commercial stakeholders to generate actionable insights.
Communication & Storytelling: You possess the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, creating engaging narratives around the results of your analyses.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

This position is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Fraud Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Founded in 2009, we're one of the world's leading game studios, and proud of our extremely international team, consisting of more than 50 different nations. We are part of Playtika and the global leader in the category of Hidden Object Games. With June's Journey, we're providing joy for millions of players around the world every day.

Our aim is to keep doing so for many more years, if not decades. No matter if you're part of a game team or support the success of Wooga as part of a central team, all 250+ employees from around the world can make an impact. We're proud of the environment we've built, and believe you'll enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry.

Our drivers: Speed, Focus, Ownership, and Impact, guide our working style at Wooga and help us make a deliberate choice to focus on what is important to us, while working towards a shared goal.

These drivers shape how we work together and what we expect from ourselves and our leaders.

As a Marketing Data Analyst, you will analyze large-scale data across user acquisition touchpoints in order to generate insightful metrics, custom dashboards, and deep-dive analyses to measure marketing performance.

Our marketing teams aim for best-in-class user acquisition strategies, bringing high-quality players to our games while driving innovation around performance marketing and targeted campaigns. We're looking for a passionate, results-oriented talent to join our team, develop new insights to shape data-driven decisions, continuously improve marketing efficiency, and help drive business growth for years to come.

About The Job


Design, build, and maintain automated, interactive dashboards in Tableau to give the Marketing team up-to-date visibility into performance and KPIs.
Dive deep into large-scale marketing data to identify key insights that will inform user acquisition strategies and business growth.
Help define how best to measure and monitor our marketing channels, creatives, budget allocation, and overall campaign performance.
Help to develop an analysis strategy and perform analysis of complex campaigns and A/B tests, both systematically and on a one-off basis.
Provide data-driven recommendations to help Marketing Managers optimize their campaigns across various channels (e.g., Facebook Audience Network, Snapchat, TikTok).
Partner with Data Engineering on data gathering and signal sharing, integrating 3rd-party data providers (e.g., AppsFlyer, Kochava), democratizing data with reporting tools, AI Agents, and innovating workflows.
Communicate actionable results and data-driven findings across the organization clearly and concisely.


About You


You have recent experience in a data analyst role, preferably in digital advertising, performance marketing, or the app industry.
You have experience with (app) Attribution Services (eg: AppsFlyer or Kochava).
Literacy on Agentic Workflows, and other productivity and modern self-service data innovations.
You can use SQL effectively within an enterprise data environment and you have a good understanding of commonly applied statistical techniques. Basic understanding of programming is not required, but is appreciated.
You have strong experience using Tableau (or similar) to build interactive dashboards and visualizations.
You have good problem-solving skills and can look for logical connections between marketing spend, consumer behavior, and data.
You have a deep understanding of the digital advertising market,including communication patterns as they relate to consumer marketing. You are in tune with user acquisition patterns, and you understand mobile app growth.
You know your way around designing, communicating, visualizing, or reporting your results/analysis so they are clear and unambiguous to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Please note: Research has shown that some under-represented groups in the gaming industry (eg: women) tend to apply only if they meet every single requirement. Here at Wooga, the desire to learn and the willingness to solve problems are more important to us than your experience on paper. We encourage you to apply even if you do not think that you tick all the boxes - thinking outside of such boxes and embracing the diversity of mindsets and backgrounds is what we believe makes our teams thrive.

Our Promise


Shape the future! Challenge the status quo and team up with a diverse group of experts (over 50 nationalities!) working on crafting the world's best games.
We offer a generous relocation package and home search support if you are not already located in Berlin. Did we mention that we also cooperate with Kindergartens?
Make use of a significant education budget and extra days off for self-development. Join our meet-ups, talks, brown bag lunches, internal trainings, workshops and many others.
Enjoy the yoga, mindfulness app, sports and transport subsidies. And a Purpose Day to donate your time to a worthy cause!
Did you know that German is the third most commonly taught language worldwide? Learn it too! We offer German language classes for you and your significant other.
With our hybrid work model you will work in the office with your teams twice a week, to encourage in-person collaboration and team bonding The other three days you can choose if you want to work from home or from the office. We also offer 10 days a year to work from abroad.


At Wooga we are committed to providing a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for everyone who works here or with us, regardless of gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, religion (or lack thereof) and game preferences. Be yourself, we like you that way!

Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Steuerberatung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt  als Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d). Das erwartet dichTeam – Als Teil unseres Global Transformation Tax Teams arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Tax, Tech und Finance an innovativen End-to-End-Lösungen, die Unternehmen fit für externe regulatorische Anforderungen und die interne Transformation machen.Analyse – Du entwickelst clevere, pragmatische Lösungsansätze zur Strukturierung, Verarbeitung und Validierung von Finanzdaten.Automatisierung – Mit Tools wie der Microsoft Power Platform oder Alteryx entwickelst du smarte Workflows und Prototypen – z. B. für Pillar 2, Tax Control Frameworks oder andere Compliance-Herausforderungen.Visualisierung – Du kreierst interaktive Dashboards und Reports in Power BI, die für die Steuerfunktion und das Management aus Finanzdaten wertvolle Erkenntnisse generieren.Integration – Du verknüpfst Tools, Datenquellen und Systeme – sei es via API, komplexer Datenmodelle oder Connector. Das bringst du mit
Du hast deinen Masterabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (bald) abgeschlossen.
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung z. B. durch Praktika, Uni-Projekte oder Selbststudium mit Datenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung und -visualisierung und verfügst über solide Kenntnisse in Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps und idealerweise Python.
Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten, Tools auszuprobieren und kreative Lösungen zu finden.
Du bringst Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echten Teamgeist mit.
Du beherrschst die Sprache Deutsch auf dem Level C2 und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.   Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Corporate Tax Teams behältst du bei nationalen und internationalen Steuerthemen den Durchblick für unsere Mandanten: Von der Buchführung und Steuererklärung über Restrukturierungen bis hin zu grenzüberschreitenden Transaktionen. Mit einem tollen Team an deiner Seite erlebst du eine erfrischende Mischung aus der Arbeit mit Zahlen und dem direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten.  Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung?Melde dich gerne bei Alisa Kullmann unter +49 69 95852697.

Title: Business Analyst, Delivery Promise (m/w/x)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.



Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Popis nabídky práce



When a customer orders a product, the "Estimated Delivery Date" (EDD) isn't just a number, it’s a commitment. As our Business Analyst for Delivery Promise, you will own the data engine driving EDD precision and End-to-End (E2E) cycle time.



We are seeking a Business Analyst, Delivery Promise to join our Fulfillment Excellence Team. This role focuses on maintaining and improving our Estimated Delivery Date (EDD) accuracy and the End-to-End (E2E) Total Cycle Time data infrastructure.



By combining data analytics with project management, the candidate will identify the root causes of operational delays and translate data insights into cross-functional corrective measures. This position impacts delivery reliability, customer satisfaction, and supply chain efficiency.



Key Responsibilities



EDD Model Development & Implementation: Design, build, test, and deploy predictive EDD models (focusing on optimizing protection buffers) across delivery regions. Collaborate with Data Science, Logistics, and IT teams to integrate these models into existing systems and refine them based on operational feedback.



Performance Reporting & Analysis: Monitor delivery performance metrics, specifically EDD accuracy and E2E Total Cycle Time. Utilize SQL, Excel, and Power BI to build dashboards, conduct trend analyses, and perform root-cause bucketization to categorize delivery delays.



Process Improvement: Partner with cross-functional teams across Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to identify operational inefficiencies. Design and implement solutions to improve delivery reliability and align cycle-time performance with business objectives.



Stakeholder Management & Communication: Serve as the point of contact for EDD and cycle-time performance. Translate data into business insights and collaborate with cross functional teams (Vendor Operations, Warehouse teams, Last Mile transportation) to manage end-to-end supply chain impacts.





Kvalifikace



Experience: A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in a data analytics role, preferably within Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and Power BI for data extraction, manipulation, and visualization.

Analytical Capabilities: Experience in KPI monitoring, root-cause analysis, and data-driven process optimization.

Project Management: Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives across multiple departments.

Advanced Tech: Familiarity with advanced data ecosystems, including knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R), exposure to ML orchestration, or experience operating in cloud data warehouse environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) is nice to have.

Languages: Full professional proficiency in English (both written and verbal) is mandatory; German, Czech, Polish, or Russian is nice to have.





Další informace



Vacation: Annual vacation of 30 calendar days and 1 additional day off on your birthday.

Wellbeing: Mental Wellbeing Program.

Growth: Learning & Development opportunities (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform).

Perks: AUTODOC Corporate Discount.

Language Classes: Free English and German language classes (after probation period).

Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model.

Future Security: Company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Allianz).







This job was posted on 29. 9. 2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: Retail Media Campaign Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Retail Media Campaign Analyst, you form the analytical and operational backbone of our local Retail Media team in Germany. Working closely with our Retail Media Managers, you own the data-driven planning, tracking, optimization, and evaluation of advertising campaigns for FMCG brands, restaurant partners, and advertisers. Operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment, you translate complex performance datasets into actionable insights, maximize campaign revenue, and prove the ROI of our partners with hard facts. Through high-quality performance reporting, you proactively surface upselling opportunities and support the team with compelling insights for both internal reviews and external client meetings. To excel in this role, you bring deep ad-tech understanding, outstanding analytical skills, and a strong collaborative mindset.

Location: Berlin (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager Retail Media

Key Responsibilities Of The Role


Analytical support, performance monitoring, and continuous data-led optimization of Retail Media and digital advertising campaigns to consistently hit client KPIs
Serving as the primary analytical partner for our Retail Media Managers regarding campaign performance, custom reporting requests, and ad-tech topics
Generating actionable insights from campaign performance and market data to drive long-term partner success
Systematically evaluating performance data to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities that support Commercial Managers in their business reviews
Building, automating, and maintaining performance dashboards, while preparing and occasionally co-delivering performance presentations for key accounts
Conducting closed-loop and attribution analyses
Collaborating closely with central Ad Operations, Data, and Product teams to continuously improve local campaign reporting standards and analytics infrastructure


What You Bring To The Team


Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field
Proven expertise in campaign analytics, reporting, and optimization across Retail Media, Search (SEA), Display Advertising, or related digital channels
Deep understanding of ad serving, DSP, SSP, and analytics platforms, as well as Programmatic Advertising and data-driven advertising solutions
Strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience querying and visualizing complex datasets (e.g., using SQL, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)
Excellent organizational skills to efficiently prioritize and manage requests across multiple stakeholders (Retail Media Managers) and active campaigns
Operational agility, quick comprehension, and adaptability within a fast-paced, high-growth business environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, commercial stories for internal teams and clients
Native/fluent German skills and professional fluency in English (written and spoken)


Our Offer

Like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! Here is what awaits you with us:

💰 A competitive compensation package that recognizes your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.

📝 A permanent employment contract with hybrid working options: three days a week in our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and two days working from home – entirely at your convenience.

🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club membership – for your work-life balance and a fresh mind in your day-to-day routine.

🍽️ Additional perks: a monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workplace.

🏠 Company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.

🌐 A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, as well as the opportunity to become part of our varied communities and ERGs (Employee Resource Groups).

😎 Shared experiences: after-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement initiatives, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Lieferando. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people’s stories, blogs, podcasts and more Lieferando and Just Eat Takeaway.com morsels.

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now

About The Role

As a Retail Media Campaign Analyst, you form the analytical and operational backbone of our local Retail Media team in Germany. Working closely with our Retail Media Managers, you own the data-driven planning, tracking, optimization, and evaluation of advertising campaigns for FMCG brands, restaurant partners, and advertisers. Operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment, you translate complex performance datasets into actionable insights, maximize campaign revenue, and prove the ROI of our partners with hard facts. Through high-quality performance reporting, you proactively surface upselling opportunities and support the team with compelling insights for both internal reviews and external client meetings. To excel in this role, you bring deep ad-tech understanding, outstanding analytical skills, and a strong collaborative mindset.

Location: Berlin (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager Retail Media

Key Responsibilities Of The Role

  • Analytical support, performance monitoring, and continuous data-led optimization of Retail Media and digital advertising campaigns to consistently hit client KPIs
  • Serving as the primary analytical partner for our Retail Media Managers regarding campaign performance, custom reporting requests, and ad-tech topics
  • Generating actionable insights from campaign performance and market data to drive long-term partner success
  • Systematically evaluating performance data to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities that support Commercial Managers in their business reviews
  • Building, automating, and maintaining performance dashboards, while preparing and occasionally co-delivering performance presentations for key accounts
  • Conducting closed-loop and attribution analyses
  • Collaborating closely with central Ad Operations, Data, and Product teams to continuously improve local campaign reporting standards and analytics infrastructure

What You Bring To The Team

  • Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field
  • Proven expertise in campaign analytics, reporting, and optimization across Retail Media, Search (SEA), Display Advertising, or related digital channels
  • Deep understanding of ad serving, DSP, SSP, and analytics platforms, as well as Programmatic Advertising and data-driven advertising solutions
  • Strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience querying and visualizing complex datasets (e.g., using SQL, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)
  • Excellent organizational skills to efficiently prioritize and manage requests across multiple stakeholders (Retail Media Managers) and active campaigns
  • Operational agility, quick comprehension, and adaptability within a fast-paced, high-growth business environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, commercial stories for internal teams and clients
  • Native/fluent German skills and professional fluency in English (written and spoken)

Our Offer

Like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! Here is what awaits you with us:

💰 A competitive compensation package that recognizes your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.

📝 A permanent employment contract with hybrid working options: three days a week in our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and two days working from home – entirely at your convenience.

🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club membership – for your work-life balance and a fresh mind in your day-to-day routine.

🍽️ Additional perks: a monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workplace.

🏠 Company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.

🌐 A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, as well as the opportunity to become part of our varied communities and ERGs (Employee Resource Groups).

😎 Shared experiences: after-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement initiatives, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Lieferando. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people’s stories, blogs, podcasts and more Lieferando and Just Eat Takeaway.com morsels.

Title: Spezialist:in Analytics und Prozessmanagement
Description:
Die Deutsche Bahn ist nicht nur einer der wichtigsten Mobilitätsdienstleister, sondern auch eines der größten Ingenieurbüros Deutschlands. Um neue Brücken, Tunnel, Bahnhöfe, Gleise und Signalanlagen zu realisieren und nachhaltig instand zu halten, arbeiten aktuell mehr als 10.000 Ingenieure bei uns – längst nicht genug. Als Ingenieur:in bei der Deutschen Bahn kannst du dabei etwas planen, managen oder überwachen, das bleibt: die Infrastruktur für kommende Generationen.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als Spezialist:in Analytics und Prozessmanagement (w/m/d) für die DB InfraGO AG am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:


Die Analyse und Bewertung von Technologien und Prozessen der Leit- und Sicherungstechnik (LST) übernimmst du unter technischen, betrieblichen und wirtschaftlichen Gesichtspunkten
Standards und Prozesse für bereichsübergreifende Projekte und Programme zur Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Leit- und Sicherungstechnik entwickelst und implementierst du
Du steuerst eigenständig Teilprojekte und behältst dabei Abhängigkeiten, Zieltermine sowie die Umsetzung relevanter Maßnahmen im Blick
Kennzahlensysteme, Reports und Dashboards zur Steuerung von Wirtschaftlichkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit und Zielerreichung konzipierst, entwickelst und optimierst du kontinuierlich weiter
Mithilfe moderner Analysetools wertest du Daten aus, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen für Technologien und Prozesse ab
Die Abstimmung mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern koordinierst du und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung eines datengetriebenen Analytics Hubs für die LST-Plattform



Dein Profil:


Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Verkehrswesen, Bahningenieurswesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Datenanalyse, Prozessmanagement, Projektmanagement oder Business Analytics zeichnet dich aus
Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Analyse und Aufbereitung komplexer Daten sowie im Umgang mit Reporting- und Visualisierungstools wie Power BI oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen
Analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für betriebliche, technische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge gehören zu deinen Stärken
Die strukturierte Entwicklung von Kennzahlen, Dashboards und datenbasierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen liegt dir und macht dir Spaß
Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder für datengetriebene Lösungen zu gewinnen, runden dein Profil ab



Das ist uns wichtig:

Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Benefits:


Wir unterstützen dich bei der Suche nach Kitaplätzen oder Ferienbetreuung für deine Kinder. Außerdem kannst du Auszeiten für die Pflege von Angehörigen oder Sabbaticals nehmen. Je nach Job ist eine flexible Gestaltung von Arbeitszeit/-ort möglich.
Wir bieten dir 16 Freifahrten innerhalb Deutschlands pro Jahr und weitere Fahrvergünstigungen wie z.B. DB Job-Ticket für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg. Darüber hinaus gibt es günstige Mitnahmemöglichkeiten für Familie und Freunde.
Bei uns können alle DB Mitarbeitenden günstig shoppen. Jeden Monat findest du auf dem DB Reisemarkt neue Angebote, wie z.B. Mobilfunkverträge, Versicherungen, Vergünstigungen bei Hotelketten, Mode und Lifestyle.



Chancengleichheit und selbstbestimmte Teilhabe Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter sowie eine respektvolle Zusammenarbeit sind innerhalb des DB Konzerns fest verankerte Grundsätze. Deshalb werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerber:innen bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Title: Referent Data Science & Reporting (m/w/d)
Description:
S-Kreditpartner – unser Name ist Programm. Und der macht auf den ersten Blick deutlich: Wir gehören zur Familie der Sparkassen. Als spezialisierter Verbundpartner bündeln wir die Aktivitäten für die Auto- und Konsumentenfinanzierung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Vertriebspartnern wollen wir die Position der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe in diesen Geschäftsfeldern stärken.

Als Referent (m/w/d) Data Scientist gestaltest Du die Banksteuerung aktiv mit und machst aus komplexen Daten klare Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Du entwickelst einheitliche Reportingstrukturen und moderne BI‑Lösungen, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige Analyse- und Reportingkonzepte und sorgst für eine konsistente, transparente und adressatengerechte Berichterstattung für Management und Fachbereiche. Gemeinsam mit den Schnittstellen in der Bank treibst Du die Weiterentwicklung von Kennzahlen-Cockpits, Dashboards und Reporting-Standards voran – und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zu einer effizienten und zukunftsorientierten Steuerung.

Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt als

Referent Data Science & Reporting (m/w/d)

Deine Aufgaben


Beratung und Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden in der Banksteuerung bei Reporting- und Analysefragestellungen
Aufbau, Vereinheitlichung und Weiterentwicklung der Reportingstrukturen sowie der eingesetzten Analyse- und Berichtstools
Definition, Abstimmung und laufende Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices, Qualitätsstandards im Reporting
Sicherstellung einer konsistenten, transparenten und adressatengerechten Berichterstattung für Management, Fachbereiche und weitere Stakeholder
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachabteilungen zur Aufnahme, Priorisierung und Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in konkrete Reporting-Lösungen
Koordination und Mitarbeit bei System- und Integrationstests im Reporting- und BI-Umfeld sowie Unterstützung beim Aufbau von Kennzahlen-Cockpits, Dashboards und Standardreports
Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Datenqualität im Reporting in enger Abstimmung mit den datenverarbeitenden Einheiten


Dein Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts‑)Informatik, Mathematik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit IT‑Schwerpunkt – oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige, einschlägige Praxiserfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Data-Analytics- und BI‑Lösungen im Banking- oder Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld
Fundierte Kenntnisse in BI-Technologien (idealerweise Power BI; alternativ Tableau, Qlik o. Ä.) sowie in SQL, Datenmodellen und relationalen Datenbanken
Erfahrung im Aufbau standardisierter Reportingstrukturen (Management-Reports, Risikoreports, KPI‑Cockpits) sowie Kenntnisse bankfachlicher KPIs und Risikokennzahlen
Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber Fachbereichen und Management
Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten und zu präsentieren
Hohe Kundenorientierung, Proaktivität und Hands-on-Mentalität


Deine Benefits


Vergütung & Finanzen: Attraktives Gehalt (tariflich) 13. Monatsgehalt im Tarif, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Essenszulage
Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub und Bankfeiertage (24.12./31.12.), flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office bzw. mobiles Arbeiten
Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden: JobRad, pme-Familienservice, moderne Hardware-Ausstattung, medizinische Vorsorge und Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille
Entwicklung & Community: Weiterbildungen, Karrieremöglichkeiten, Welcome-Veranstaltung, Events

Title: Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d)
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Strategy, Risk & Transactions – Advisory – Mergers & Acquisitions Kunden entlang des gesamten M&A-Deal-Zyklus begleiten – von Strategie und Due Diligence über Finanzierungs- und Technologiefragen bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und Integration von Transaktionen? Unser Team unterstützt Mandanten beim Kauf, Verkauf oder Zusammenschluss von Unternehmen - strategisch, finanziell und rechtlich. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg und München.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten bei komplexen M&A-Transaktionen – und kombinierst dabei Finance-Expertise mit Data Analytics, um nachhaltige Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.


Data Analytics: Mit Hilfe modernster Analytics-Methoden bereitest du große Datenmengen effizient auf, erkennst Muster und prüfst Hypothesen datenbasiert – unterstützt durch unsere etablierten Best Practices.
Datenmuster: Du identifizierst Datenmuster, um aufgestellte Hypothesen zu prüfen, und verknüpfst entscheidungsrelevante Daten und Informationen.
Visualisierung: Interaktive Dashboards konzipierst du mit Business-Intelligence-Tools, sodass komplexe Finanzinformationen für Stakeholder verständlich dargestellt werden.
Stakeholder-Kommunikation: In deinen Projekten generierst du gemeinsam mit Data-Science-Experten wertschaffende Einblicke und kommunizierst datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen an ausgewählte Stakeholder.
Dokumentation & Weiterbildung: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Investor Documents wie Data Books und Due-Diligence-Berichten und entwickelst dein Wissen zu neuen Technologien und Methoden kontinuierlich weiter.


Dein Skillset:


Sehr guter Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Fachwissen
Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie R, Python, SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Power BI oder Qlik Sense
Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Kommunikationsstärke und Präsentationssicherheit


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Title: Senior Sales Analyst (d/f/m) 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

In the Kleinanzeagen PRO Business Unit, we are scaling a high-growth SMB powerhouse. To achieve our ambitious growth targets, we are looking for a Senior Sales Analyst who will closely collaborate with PRO Sales leadership to bring our reporting and insight generation to the next level.

This role is designed for an independent decision-enabler who can challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining tight organization over their backlog and execution.

Job requirements

Your Profile


Experience: 4–5+ years of hands-on experience in mid-to-senior sales analytics roles, ideally within a marketplace (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Allegro), SaaS, or E-Commerce environment.
Core technical stack: Advanced SQL skills (code optimization) alongside proven hands-on experience with Salesforce data (must) and Databricks (must). Proficiency with Python, dbt, and CI/CD workflows is a strong plus.
Modern data architecture: Solid understanding of modern data flows (Salesforce -> Databricks -> dbt -> BI/Products) and analytics infrastructure. Ability to partner with Data Engineering and Platform teams to design scalable solutions.
Advanced & predictive analytics: Proven track record with advanced analytical techniques and statistical forecasting methods to convert complex datasets into predictive insights.
Visualization & reporting: Demonstrated experience with data visualization platforms; Tableau and Databricks Dashboards are a major plus.
Modern AI integration: Practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows. Knowing when to automate versus when to perform deep manual analysis. Using agentic AI as a daily companion, with a proven track record of leveraging AI tooling (especially Claude) to execute both tedious administrative tasks and high-value deliverables efficiently.
Stakeholder management & ownership mindset: Decision-focused with a strong sense of end-to-end ownership, accountability, and backlog prioritization. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and translating complex data for non-technical audiences.
Languages: Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage.


Job responsibilities

Your Role


Drive partner & professional sellers’ self-service analytics: Build a robust, scalable self-service reporting base for our professional sellers, as well as partners and associations.
Automate sales campaign reporting: Restructure campaign management and reporting, driving the shift toward automated, self-service channel data.
Lead data Integration & modeling: Ingest, model, and integrate third-party partner data streams directly into internal systems alongside data engineers, platform teams, and external Salesforce consultants.
Cross-functional collaboration & sales enablement: Act as a sparring partner for sales stakeholders by providing access to critical data, translating business requirements into scalable solutions, and leading cross-functional alignment.
Attribution & performance intelligence: Deliver revenue reconciliation, attribution models, market intelligence, and risk/opportunity recommendations to optimize sales performance.
Advanced analytics & future foundations: Lay the analytics foundations for forward-looking predictions and sales forecasting models to support strategic decision-making.
AI Integration: Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

✨ Flexibility


Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events
Pension and life insurance


📚 Growth & Development


Personal development budget
Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career


🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits


Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
An attractive referral program
Transportation allowance
Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf


Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.




From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.




Who we need

Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.




Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.

Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.




What you will be doing

Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.
Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses.
Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team.
Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports.
Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards.
Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns.
Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities.




What we need from you

Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels.
Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks.
Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently.
Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus.
Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles.
A can-do attitude and positive mindset with a proactive approach to overcoming challenges and a passion for driving continuous improvement.
Great conduct in English. German is a plus.
Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire.




What we offer you

An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals.
We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact.
We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things.
We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation.
We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so.
Truly a hybrid work environment. You are not required to come to the office, but you will want to.




Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.




Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.




If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.
