Title: Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:

  • Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
  • Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
  • Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
  • Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
  • Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
  • Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.

About You

  • Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
  • Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
  • Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
  • Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
  • Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Gemeinsam helfen wir dabei, Technologie-, Prozess-, Kontroll- und Projektrisiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu minimieren. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Title: Product Analyst Lead
Description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.




Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.




You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.




Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!




This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.




YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up
Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions




YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it




Bonus points for:

Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
A strong statistics background
Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
Data catalogues like DataHub




OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
Experimentation: GrowthBook
Self-service analytics: Omni
ML workflows: Prefect
GenAI: Claude




If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.




WHY US?

An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health




DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.




READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

Your CV in English
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Title: Analytical Consultant, Germany (Fixed-Term Contract)
Description:
This Fixed-Term Contract is effective immediately through March 2028 (18 months), with the position located in Germany.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Hamburg, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Munich, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, consulting, data analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leveraging AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Experience and ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently in order to support a client-facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within DE LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel to Media and Entertainment and many digital players. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

The Insights and Analytics team within Digital First empowers our customers in achieving their business and marketing objectives by providing them with data-driven bases for decision-making. The team uses business acumen combined with storytelling skills to partner closely with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and support the transformation and shifts required to be successful in an ever-changing market environment. The team leverages Google's internal search data and external market data to uncover actionable insights, driving informed decision-making and fostering mutual growth for our customers and Google.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising Return on Investment (ROI).
Consult with clients as a consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals. Develop compelling insights and narratives to influence client.
Streamline processes and leverages AI to deliver insights at scale, efficiently.
Work seamlessly with teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement specialists).
Empower internal stakeholders and clients by democratizing insights and by delivering training and guidance on interpreting insights from data.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

Title: eCommerce Growth Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an eCommerce Growth Analyst to join our eCommerce Solutions team to lead data analytics and real-time tracking, ensuring the quality and stability of our rapidly growing white-label solution.




What you will do:

Performance Optimisation & Analytics: lead site performance optimisation through advanced analytics tools and data-driven insights.
Monitoring & Growth Analysis: monitor key metrics such as traffic, user behaviour, and conversion rates to identify growth opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Analytics Tools & Tracking: leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and heatmaps to track, measure, and analyse website performance.
A/B Testing & CRO: implement A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) strategies to improve user engagement and conversion performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: collaborate closely with marketing, UX, and development teams to enhance user experience and overall site effectiveness.
Tag Management & Data Accuracy: ensure accurate website tracking, including the setup and management of tags in Google Tag Manager for reliable data collection.




Workplace: Germany & Remote // Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.




Who you are:

Experience & Background: 4+ years of experience in growth, product optimisation, or similar roles within B2C e-commerce or consumer digital products.
Conversion Optimisation & Experimentation: strong hands-on experience improving website and app conversion funnels through experimentation, user behaviour analysis, and data-driven decision making.
Analytics & Tools: strong hands-on experience with tools such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, SQL, Grafana, Hotjar, and A/B testing platforms like AB Tasty, Maxymizer, or Optimizely.
Ownership & Problem Solving: strong ownership mindset with the ability to proactively investigate root causes and drive solutions when metrics or user behaviour change unexpectedly.
Customer & Product Mindset: customer-focused and curious about user behaviour, with the ability to identify friction points and opportunities to improve conversion and overall experience.
Analytical Thinking: ability to turn complex business problems into clear hypotheses, experiments, and actionable product improvements.
Collaboration & Ways of Working: comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and commercial teams.
Communication Skills: clear communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability & Impact: thrives in fast-moving environments, adapts quickly to ambiguity, and is motivated by driving measurable business impact.




What you can expect:

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company




Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Benedetta, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Francesc Ferre.




For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability, scalability and the most advanced technology? Come join us!

Title: Manager Data Analytics, Global Marketing (m/f/d)
Description:
Location: Berlin or Stäfa, Hybrid




We are looking for a Manager Data Analytics to establish and lead the day-to-day analytics capability within our Global Marketing organization. As the first dedicated data analytics expert in the team, you will have the opportunity to shape how we use data across brands, products, markets and consumer touchpoints.

This is an individual contributor analytics role that sits close to the business. You will work directly with marketing, product and portfolio stakeholders, helping them understand what the data means, what actions to take and how analytics can support better decisions for our brands and consumers. While embedded in Global Marketing, you will be connected to a broader community of analytics experts and work closely with our central Data & Data Science function.




Your Responsibilities




Partner with Global Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, KPIs and decision-ready insights
Deliver analyses across areas such as product usage, NPS and voice of the customer, campaign performance, digital behavior, funnel performance and customer feedback
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and self-service analytics solutions
Combine information from different data sources and transform complex datasets into clear business stories, implications and recommendations
Act as Global Marketing’s main interface to the central data and data science organization for advanced analytics and cross-functional projects
Support test-and-learn initiatives, A/B testing and experimental approaches
Manage recurring and ad hoc analytics requests while helping stakeholders prioritize the topics with the greatest business impact




What You Bring




A degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, economics, marketing analytics or a related field
At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or digital analytics
Strong experience working with large and complex datasets and translating them into actionable insights for business stakeholders
Hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL and Excel; knowledge of Python or R is an advantage
A good understanding of KPI frameworks, data visualization and applied business analytics
A self-starting, structured and independent working style, combined with strong stakeholder-management skills
Fluency in English; German is an advantage.




Why join us




This is a unique opportunity to become the analytics subject-matter expert embedded directly within Global Marketing.
You will have the freedom to build the analytics capability, establish effective ways of working and create your own path within an international marketing organization.




As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.




Our benefits in Berlin:

30 days of paid annual leave
Subsidized VBB or Deutschland ticket
Dedicated learning & development budget and weekly learning time + LinkedIn Learning license
Company Urban Sports Club membership
Mobility allowance for relocation if you are relocating to join our team




Sonova is an equal opportunity employer.

Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Corporate Functions - Performance & Reward ein attraktives, motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld gestalten? Unser Team entwickelt Konzepte und Programme rund um die Themen Karriere, Benefits, Recognition oder (leistungsbezogene) Vergütung. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d).

Standorte: Düsseldorf, Berlin, Dresden, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Leipzig, Magdeburg, Mannheim, München, Nürnberg und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Rolle als Data Scientist zur Entwicklung datengestützter Modelle zur Aufbereitung und Interpretation entscheidungsrelevanter Daten.

  • Konzeption: Du entwickelst geeignete Algorithmen und Modelle zur Aufbereitung entscheidungsrelevanter Daten und erschaffst individuelle Dashboards anhand moderner Business-Intelligence-Tools.
  • Verifizierung: Um deine aufgestellten Hypothesen zu prüfen, identifizierst du Zusammenhänge und Muster in deinen Daten.
  • Entwicklung: Gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern entwickelst du Reporting und Analysetools.
  • Präsentation: Strukturierte Aufbereitung der Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen und Reporting-Anforderungen.
  • Management: Selbstständig identifizierst und entwickelst du Schritt für Schritt den notwendigen Prozess zur Entwicklung der gesamte Wertschöpfungs- und Engagementkette.

Dein Skillset:

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik bspw. mit Schwerpunkt Statistik, Data Analytics oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung z. B. im Bereich Analytics und/oder Projektmanagement
  • Der Umgang mit großen Datenmengen in einem hochvertraulichen Umfeld ist für dich kein Problem
  • (Erste) Programmierkenntnisse in R, Python, SQL oder vergleichbar sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Qlik, Sense oder PowerBI
  • Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten und einen hohen Anspruch an die eigenen Arbeitsergebnisse

Deine Chance:

  • Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
  • Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
  • Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
  • Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperation mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
  • Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungsräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Noch Fragen? Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs.

Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

Title: Specialist Datenmanagement (m/w/d)
Description:
Worum geht's?


Ausschreibungen: Durch die Aufbereitung und Strukturierung von Daten unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung bei der Akquise und Erstellung von Inputmaterial im Zuge von Ausschreibungen der Dualen Systeme.
Analyse & Business Intelligence: Du analysierst, visualisierst und überarbeitest verschiedene Datenquellen mit Excel und Power BI und leitest daraus wertvolle Erkenntnisse für das Unternehmen ab.
Programmierung & Automatisierung: Du nutzt Excel/VBA sowie weitere digitale Werkzeuge, um Arbeitsabläufe zu automatisieren und effizienter zu gestalten.
Optimierung: Du entwickelst und verbesserst Prozessabläufe und nutzt Excel, VBA, Power Query sowie DAX, um Daten effizient auf- und vorzubereiten.
Entwicklung: Du entwickelst Dashboards oder Tools und erstellst Dateivorlagen, um Arbeitsprozesse zu vereinfachen und zu standardisieren.
Mitgestaltung: Du wirkst aktiv am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der zukünftigen Datenlandschaft mit und gestaltest so die Zukunft des Unternehmens nachhaltig mit.


Neugierig? Deine Vorteile:


Vergütung: Du erhältst eine attraktive Vergütung sowie diverse Zusatzleistungen (Mitarbeitervergünstigungen, kostenlose Getränke etc.).
Team: Du wirst Teil eines motivierten, dynamischen und hilfsbereiten Teams.
Einarbeitung: Wir arbeiten Dich umfassend und strukturiert in Deine Aufgaben ein.
Entwicklung: Du arbeitest in einem innovativen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Flexibilität: Dank der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel.
Benefits: Freue Dich auf Bike-Leasing, Deutschlandticket sowie ein breit aufgestelltes Gesundheitsmanagement und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.
Zukunft: Als Teil eines führenden Umweltdienstleisters gestaltest Du die Zukunft des Unternehmens aktiv mit. Umfangreiche Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangebote unterstützen Dich dabei.


Dein Profil:


Ausbildung: Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, IT- oder technischen Bereich abgeschlossen.
Kenntnisse: Du bringst umfangreiche Kenntnisse im Datenmanagement mit und verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Ad-hoc-Analysen.
IT-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über umfassende Microsoft-365-Kenntnisse und bist versiert im Umgang mit Excel (fortgeschritten bis Experte). Komplexe Formeln, Pivot-Tabellen, Diagramme, Datenvalidierung, Power Query und Power BI gehören für Dich zum Arbeitsalltag.
VBA & Automatisierung: Du programmierst in VBA oder vergleichbaren Tools, um Arbeitsprozesse zu automatisieren und effizienter zu gestalten.
Power BI & Power Automate: Du erstellst Auswertungen und Dashboards in Power BI und bringst idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in Power Automate für kleinere Automatisierungen mit.
Datenmanagement & Systeme: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Unternehmenssystemen, beispielsweise bei der Stammdatenpflege, dem Fehlermonitoring oder der Durchführung von Systemtests. Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil.
Arbeitsstil: Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative mit.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

Title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/x)
Description:
Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.



Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.



Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.



Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).





Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI

Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark
Description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a leading Berlin-based productivity software scale-up.

The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.

Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.

The Role

Job Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark

Location: Berlin, Germany

Why this role matters

Our email client is scaling fast, and we need to move from tracking data to aggressively predicting and validating what drives growth. Without this role, our product and marketing teams cannot rapidly iterate, run quasi-experiments, or build the deep causal inference models needed to unlock our next stage of subscription revenue. You will be the critical engine that turns raw user touchpoints into strategic, high-impact product decisions.

What You'll Do

You will own the entire growth loop analytics for our email client, ensuring every stage from first ad impression to long-term subscription renewal is fully measurable.


Design robust event tracking structures and instrumentation to ensure flawless measurement across the entire user journey.
Build and maintain growth dashboards in Tableau or Looker that make acquisition and retention performance crystal clear for cross-functional teams.
Uncover growth opportunities by digging deep into funnels, user cohorts, and subscription metrics like churn and LTV.
Design and execute A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal inference models to validate marketing and product hypotheses.
Deploy advanced forecasting models using Python or R to predict long-term subscription dynamics and trend lines.


What success looks like

Month 1: You will deeply integrate with the product and marketing teams, audit our current data pipelines in BigQuery and tracking setups in Amplitude and AppsFlyer, and identify immediate tracking improvements.

Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of our growth dashboards, design and launch your first batch of A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and establish a standardized methodology for measuring marketing attribution.

By end of Q1: You will have built a reliable, end-to-end subscription analytics framework that clearly connects first-click marketing attribution to long-term cohort retention, enabling swift, data-backed product decisions.

Who This Is a Fit For


Have 5+ years of analytics experience in B2C mobile apps or subscription SaaS.
Expert-level SQL wizard with hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
Fluent in visualization and product analytics tools like Tableau, Looker, and Amplitude.
Experienced with mobile marketing attribution mechanics using platforms like AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Proficient in Python or R for time-series forecasting and causal inference.
Thrive on high autonomy, taking full personal responsibility for product outcomes.


What it's like to work here

The company's culture is rooted in deep customer-centricity and continuous professional growth, with a massive emphasis on individual autonomy and ownership. Team members are expected to drive their own initiatives and take full responsibility for product outcomes. Decision-making is highly collaborative yet swift, heavily guided by data analysis, rapid iteration, and continuous experimentation to validate product hypotheses. This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing, demanding a proactive builder who thrives on fast feedback loops and constant adaptation.

The offer


Work in our Berlin office within a culture that prioritizes your professional growth.
Massive autonomy to drive your own initiatives and experiments.
A highly collaborative environment that values data-backed, swift decision-making.


This probably isn't for you if


You prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned rather than proactively finding growth opportunities.
You struggle to make decisions without absolute certainty or dislike rapid, constant iteration.
You want a pure modeling role without getting your hands dirty with event-tracking design.


Who are Atlas & Nova?

I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.

And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.

Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.

Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Nova a try. You could land this role. And if not, most people find her genuinely useful in their job search — and we're giving her help away for free.

Title: Senior Business Analyst (all genders) - Lounge by Zalando - Parental Leave Cover (12 months)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

As a Senior Business Analyst in our Supply Analytics team at Zalando Lounge, you will work alongside the Supply team and leadership toward our vision of acquiring unmatched value-for-money deals that drive Lounge user acquisition, conversion, and retention.

In this role, you will build on your analytical and statistical skills to generate actionable business insights that enable smarter decision-making. You will lead and implement initiatives to develop sustainable reporting solutions and create fact-based insights regarding our partner (supplier) lifecycle and pricing dynamics, from both quantity and quality perspectives. You will actively collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders by sharing relevant context based on the key performance indicators (KPIs) you track, analyze, and embed across the business. To succeed in this role, you should possess a naturally analytical mindset and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

About Lounge By Zalando

Lounge by Zalando is an online outlet for fashion and lifestyle products in 25 European countries.

We offer our members daily, time-limited sale campaigns with discounts of up to 75% off the recommended retail price.

However, Lounge by Zalando is so much more than discounts. Our strength lies in our focus on fashion: from sought-after labels to niche brands, from famous international names to trendy luxury brands, we make sure to meet the fashion taste of all our customers, who are always on the hunt for the best products at the best prices.

Working with our brand partners, we're pioneering innovative supply-chain and production processes and offer them an impactful and smart solution, creating a new way to shop for fashion - and a new way to sell it.

Our motto: Not your average outlet.

https://www.zalando-lounge.de

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Operationalize Business Reporting: Develop a deep understanding of our business processes, tools, and overall data landscape to build, implement, and operationalize reporting focused on Partner insights and Pricing capabilities for Zalando Lounge (connecting inventory, sales, supply, planning, and steering).
Drive Analytical Insights: Formulate and test hypotheses using descriptive, exploratory, and quantitative analyses to generate impactful business insights while identifying emerging risks and strategic opportunities.
Engage Senior Stakeholders: Present complex analytical findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders in a visually compelling, easily digestible manner (using Tableau or Databricks) to advance our collective intelligence.
Deliver End-to-End Analytics: Take full accountability for all stages of data analysis, research, and data visualization using narrative storytelling, while leading high-impact Data & Analytics projects and initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with technology and data teams across Zalando to maximize the utility of existing datasets and ensure optimal access to high-value data points.


WE'D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


Technical Expertise: You are a highly proficient user of Tableau and Databricks, with strong SQL skills (Python is a plus). You work autonomously with these tools and can effectively guide others in using them.
Proven Impact & Domain Knowledge: You have led initiatives or projects that enabled businesses to make high-impact decisions through your insights or developed solutions. Domain expertise in inventory management or the planning and steering of sales and supply is a strong plus.
Education & Experience: You hold a degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a similar quantitative field, paired with 5+ years of professional experience in a similar role (ideally in a fast-paced e-commerce or retail environment). Knowledge of statistical methods is a plus.
Mindset & Adaptability: Collaborators value your drive to make an impact, your ability to spot inefficiencies with a hands-on approach, and your knack for finding simple, efficient solutions to complex challenges. You are proactive and adapt quickly to change while remaining focused on key objectives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: You balance technical acumen with business understanding, excelling at collaborating with commercial stakeholders to generate actionable insights.
Communication & Storytelling: You possess the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, creating engaging narratives around the results of your analyses.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

This position is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Title: Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d)
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Strategy, Risk & Transactions – Advisory – Mergers & Acquisitions Kunden entlang des gesamten M&A-Deal-Zyklus begleiten – von Strategie und Due Diligence über Finanzierungs- und Technologiefragen bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und Integration von Transaktionen? Unser Team unterstützt Mandanten beim Kauf, Verkauf oder Zusammenschluss von Unternehmen - strategisch, finanziell und rechtlich. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg und München.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten bei komplexen M&A-Transaktionen – und kombinierst dabei Finance-Expertise mit Data Analytics, um nachhaltige Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.


Data Analytics: Mit Hilfe modernster Analytics-Methoden bereitest du große Datenmengen effizient auf, erkennst Muster und prüfst Hypothesen datenbasiert – unterstützt durch unsere etablierten Best Practices.
Datenmuster: Du identifizierst Datenmuster, um aufgestellte Hypothesen zu prüfen, und verknüpfst entscheidungsrelevante Daten und Informationen.
Visualisierung: Interaktive Dashboards konzipierst du mit Business-Intelligence-Tools, sodass komplexe Finanzinformationen für Stakeholder verständlich dargestellt werden.
Stakeholder-Kommunikation: In deinen Projekten generierst du gemeinsam mit Data-Science-Experten wertschaffende Einblicke und kommunizierst datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen an ausgewählte Stakeholder.
Dokumentation & Weiterbildung: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Investor Documents wie Data Books und Due-Diligence-Berichten und entwickelst dein Wissen zu neuen Technologien und Methoden kontinuierlich weiter.


Dein Skillset:


Sehr guter Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Fachwissen
Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie R, Python, SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Power BI oder Qlik Sense
Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Kommunikationsstärke und Präsentationssicherheit


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr

Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working

Title: Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Title: Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen
Description:
Über uns

Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Sie bietet Biotech-, Pharma- und Medizinprodukteunternehmen Lösungen für den Market Access, Preisbildung und Erstattung ihrer medizinischen Innovationen. Das Unternehmen ist in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Spanien, Schweden, der Schweiz und Großbritannien vertreten und unterstützt auch bei multinationalen Produkteinführungen. IGES ist Teil der Athagoras Gruppe, die verschiedene Beratungsunternehmen für die Lifescience-Branche vereint.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Value Strategy & RWE suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt an unserem Standort in Berlin einen Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen

Ihre Aufgaben


Konzeption, Durchführung, Auswertung und Interpretation von Analysen auf Basis von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Kohortendefinition bis zur Ergebnisaufarbeitung
Interpretation und Einordnung der Analyseergebnisse zur Generierung belastbarer Real World Evidence sowie deren Übersetzung in strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden
Strategische Beratung von Market-Access-, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen führender Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Fachliche Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung von Analysen in interdisziplinären Projekten sowie Anleitung weniger erfahrener Kolleginnen und Kollegen
Unterstützung bei HTA-relevanten Fragestellungen (z. B. Evidenzanforderungen, PICO-Scoping, Analysestrategien) sowie Transfer der Ergebnisse in Publikationen, Präsentationen und Projektberichte
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung der Befunde aus Abrechnungsdaten
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, für Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ-Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen, z. B. in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen


Ihre Qualifikation


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Versorgungsforschung, Public Health, Gesundheitsökonomie, Statistik, Epidemiologie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – im industriellen oder akademischen Umfeld
Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Analyseergebnisse eigenständig zu interpretieren, zu Real World Evidence zu verdichten und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit epidemiologischen und statistischen Methoden, soweit für die anwendungsnahe Auswertung von Abrechnungsdaten erforderlich
Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumente, z. B. Studienprotokolle, Studienberichte oder Publikationen
Programmierkenntnisse in R oder Python von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen sind willkommen, aber nicht Voraussetzung
Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Team- und Kundenorientierung
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)


Unser Angebot


Mitarbeit in abwechslungsreichen Projekten zu hochinnovativen Arzneimitteln an der Schnittstelle von Versorgungsforschung, Real-World-Evidence und strategischer Beratung
Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und guten Entwicklungsperspektiven
Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projektarbeit, viel Raum für eigene Ideen und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen (z. B. Konferenzen)
Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung großer Abrechnungsdatensätze sowie frühzeitiger Kompetenzaufbau im Hinblick auf das FDZ Gesundheit
Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung am Standort Berlin, inklusive Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
Unbefristete Festanstellung mit marktgerechter Vergütung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester


Kontaktinformation

Wenn Sie diese Aufgabe reizt, freuen wir uns über Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins hier über die Direktbewerbung oder per Mail an Frau Alina Weber (personal@iges.com).
