We're looking for


you as a Senior Analytics Engineer, to make an important contribution to climate neutrality together with us at thermondo. With your interest in renewable energies and your identification with our values, We do what we say, Better everyday, Stronger together, you will create real added value for us all.


As a certified professional with at least 5 years of experience in the field, you are passionate about transforming data into strategic insights and driving impactful business decisions. At thermondo, a leading clean tech company, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where your unique perspectives are valued.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will be able to lead the development of cutting-edge data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a sustainable future. If you're ready to make a difference and thrive in a dynamic environment, Thermondo is the place for you to join our innovative journey towards a sustainable future.

If you enjoy this


Connecting and integrating various data sources, including APIs, to ensure data quality and reliability.
Performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and actionable insights.
Creating dashboards and visualizations using tools like Looker or Tableau.
Collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to prioritize tasks and deliver analytics solutions that meet business needs.
Monitoring and validating analytics systems for performance and accuracy
Extending existing data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Airflow, PubSub).


And recognise yourself here

Possessing strong knowledge of API connections and integrations.
Experienced with data visualization platforms like Looker or Power BI.
First experience with using GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
Excellent communication skills, effectively connecting data and business teams by translating business strategies into actionable technical insights, with fluency in English.

Join a team of dynamic, data-driven, and enthusiastic people who excel at their craft and are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow with them.
We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world will become for future generations
A corporate culture that brings people from all walks of life together - regardless of gender, origin, age, or background.
A modern office in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg with a roof terrace, where dogs are also welcome.
Work flexibly from the mobile office - up to 3 days a week.

Description:
This Fixed-Term Contract is effective immediately through March 2028 (18 months), with the position located in Germany.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Hamburg, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Munich, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, consulting, data analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leveraging AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Experience and ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently in order to support a client-facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within DE LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel to Media and Entertainment and many digital players. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

The Insights and Analytics team within Digital First empowers our customers in achieving their business and marketing objectives by providing them with data-driven bases for decision-making. The team uses business acumen combined with storytelling skills to partner closely with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and support the transformation and shifts required to be successful in an ever-changing market environment. The team leverages Google's internal search data and external market data to uncover actionable insights, driving informed decision-making and fostering mutual growth for our customers and Google.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising Return on Investment (ROI).
Consult with clients as a consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals. Develop compelling insights and narratives to influence client.
Streamline processes and leverages AI to deliver insights at scale, efficiently.
Work seamlessly with teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement specialists).
Empower internal stakeholders and clients by democratizing insights and by delivering training and guidance on interpreting insights from data.

Title: Consultant Data Analytics ERP Migrations (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Wirtschaftsprüfung und prüfungsnahe Beratung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics (w/m/d).

 

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

IT-Lösungen – Du entwickelst mit deinem Team innovative IT-Lösungen zur Analyse von großen Datenmengen. Dies schließt die Konzeption und die Umsetzung von nachhaltigen Business Intelligence und Big Data Lösungen zur Prüfung und Durchführung von ERP-Transformationsprojekten ein.

Projektarbeit – Du arbeitest in vielseitigen Projekten bei führenden Industrieunternehmen, Banken und Versicherungen im internationalen Kontext. Dabei entwickelst du innovative Produkte und kundenspezifische Lösungen im Bereich Analytics, Reporting und Big Data – Du betreust Kunden und hilfst bei der Neukundenakquise.

Technologieerklärung – Du kennst die Welt der Datenanalyse und kannst Kunden verständlich näherbringen, welche Möglichkeiten ihnen moderne Analytics Methoden und -Werkzeuge im SAP-Umfeld eröffnen und wie sie diese in bestehende BI & Analytics Landschaften integrieren.

 

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Gemeinsam helfen wir dabei, Technologie-, Prozess-, Kontroll- und Projektrisiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu minimieren. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Melde dich gerne bei Nadine Beth unter +49 151 15291123.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company

Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

Pet friendly offices

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

About Us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Data Analytics Team 👋

Data Analytics is central to how we build better products, support our partners and grow our business. Our Data Analysts are embedded across cross-functional teams spanning product, commercial and industry initiatives, working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Commercial teams, Embedded Data Scientists and the wider Data organisation to enable confident, evidence-based decision making. As a Data Analyst within Enterprise Solutions, our B2B arm, you will help shape the future of rail through business travellers and wider retail innovation, supporting partners across the industry with data-driven insight that improves how rail travel is sold, delivered and experienced.

You will work closely with Embedded Data Scientists, Product Managers and commercial colleagues to structure analytical approaches, interpret findings and translate complex data into insight that informs product strategy and partner-facing solutions. This role sits within a growing Data organisation that includes Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Data Product Management, offering the opportunity to contribute to decisions that shape the next generation of rail retail and enterprise capability.

In this role as the Data Analyst, you will... 🚄


Analyse partner and customer behaviour to inform the development of enterprise and retail solutions.
Translate complex analysis into clear, compelling insights and practical recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Produce high-quality analytical deliverables, dashboards, reports and presentations that help senior stakeholders and external partners make informed decisions.
Work closely with Data Scientists to structure analytical approaches, interpret findings and draw meaningful conclusions from large and complex datasets.
Collaborate across Data, Product and Design to ensure insight is embedded into decision making from early exploration through to delivery.
Help define how we measure success across TPS products and partner solutions.
Contribute to a growing Data organisation that includes Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Data Product Management.
Support the development of innovative retail and enterprise solutions that help shape the future of rail.


We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔎


Experience using analytics to support business decisions, answer complex commercial questions and identify opportunities for improvement.

Title: Performance and Data Analyst (SEND)
Description:
Performance Data Analyst (SEND)

Job Summary:

Are you passionate about using data to improve outcomes for children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND)? Do you thrive in a high-impact analytical role where your work directly informs strategic decision-making and service transformation?

This is an exciting opportunity to help transform SEND services through data and intelligence. You will work closely with senior leaders and partners to improve outcomes for children and young people across Ealing.

Ealing Council have an exciting new opportunity as Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) available on a full time. We are seeking a skilled and motivated Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) to join our Schools Data, Performance and Intelligence team. The post holder will play a key role in supporting SEND services by delivering high-quality insight and ensuring statutory reporting is accurate and timely, including SEN2.

In this role you will also contribute to shaping data systems, supporting SEND reforms, and enabling senior leaders to make informed decisions that improve outcomes for residents.

We strive to create communities where everyone can live a long, happy, and healthy life, full of pride and identity. We aim to create an environment where every child can reach their potential and achieve their dreams.

The Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) role:


Lead statutory returns (including SEN2) ensuring compliance and deadlines are met
Develop and enhance data systems and reporting frameworks
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and inform planning
Produce high-quality dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI)
Provide expert advice on data interpretation and performance
Support forecasting including specialist school place planning
Collaborate with services, ICT and partners to improve data systems
Ensure strong data quality, validation and GDPR compliance


Our ideal Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) will have the below skills and experience:


Advanced skills in Excel, SQL and Power BI
Strong analytical and forecasting capability
Experience working with large datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
Experience in SEND, education or public sector


We are not accepting CVs, you must complete a supporting statement providing examples of how you meet each of the criteria in the job description section of the role profile. Any applications received with a CV will not be progressed or reviewed.

You must have the right to work in the UK. Evidence for the right to work in the UK will be requested at the interview stage.

It is an exciting time to join us, here at Ealing Council. If you would like to make a positive difference to our residents and borough, then we’re looking forward to hearing from you.

Please note all applications will be determined on merit.

Closing date for applications: Wednesday 30 September 2026

Data Analyst, Insurance Broking

London | Hybrid

60K




Arthur is partnering with a leading global insurance broker to appoint an experienced Data Analyst into its growing analytics function.




This is a highly technical and commercially focused role, working closely with brokers and insurance professionals to transform complex insurance datasets into meaningful insight. You’ll have the opportunity to work across data analytics, Python engineering, automation, data quality and visualisation, helping improve how data is used to support client and placement decisions.




The Role

You’ll work as part of a specialist analytics team, partnering closely with brokers and other stakeholders to understand their data requirements and deliver high quality analysis.

• Analyse large and complex insurance datasets, providing insight across claims experience, loss ratios, exposure, portfolio performance and market trends

• Work closely with brokers and stakeholders to provide data driven insight supporting client and placement decisions

• Design, build and optimise Python data pipelines to ingest, cleanse, transform and standardise data from multiple sources

• Use Python, Pandas, SQL and modern development practices to create efficient, repeatable and auditable analytical processes

• Develop automated data quality checks, controls and validation processes to improve the accuracy and reliability of data

• Support the development of centralised exposure, claims and portfolio databases, including relational database and schema design

• Build analytical tools, dashboards and benchmarking datasets to compare portfolios across clients, classes of business and different time periods

• Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve the efficiency of existing analytics workflows

• Produce clear and engaging visualisations and reporting using Power BI, Excel and Power Query

• Explore emerging technologies across Data, Analytics, Automation and AI and how they can be applied within insurance broking




About You

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical data capabilities with an understanding of the insurance market.

• 3+ years’ experience within a Data Analyst, Senior Data Analyst or similar analytics role

• Previous experience within Insurance, Reinsurance, Insurance Broking or the London Market

• Strong Python skills, particularly Pandas, data cleansing, transformation and automation

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Supply
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable participant marketplace will be critical to our ability to meet growing demand for high-quality human data. We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can independently drive strategic marketplace analytics and act as an end-to-end partner across product, operations, and leadership.

What you’ll bring to the role


Senior Analytics Expertise: Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency (e.g. pandas, experimentation analysis, automation), with a proven track record of architecting scalable reporting frameworks and data marts in modern BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Hex). Demonstrated capability to independently own ambiguous problems end-to-end — from complex raw data to executive-ready strategic insights.
Lifecycle Analytics: Experience analysing user acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn, and behavioural cohorts.
Experimentation & Statistics: Experience designing and analysing A/B or operational experiments, with solid grounding in statistical concepts and causal thinking.
Product Thinking: Ability to translate participant and marketplace challenges into measurable hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable recommendations.
Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect operational metrics to revenue, margin, and financial performance — understanding not just what is happening, but why it matters commercially.
Strategic Autonomy & Ownership: Exceptional ability to operate with high autonomy in a dynamic environment, independently setting priorities, challenging assumptions, framing complex problems, and driving strategic initiatives from initial hypothesis through execution.
Executive Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of influencing senior leadership and cross-functional partners across Product, Operations, Commercial, and Finance functions, telling compelling data-driven stories that shape strategy.
Marketplace Understanding: Strong grasp of B2B and two-sided marketplace metrics and economics.
Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready insights that shape strategy and execution.


What you'll be doing


Autonomously own analytics across the full participant lifecycle—from acquisition and onboarding through activation, engagement, quality, retention, and reactivation
Define and build strategic metrics, executive-facing dashboards, and robust experimentation frameworks that reveal participant behavior and optimize marketplace dynamics
Work closely with Product, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Executive Leadership to identify growth drivers, structure complex experiments, and translate intricate marketplace data into high-impact strategic decisions
Work hands-on across SQL, Python, experimentation, and senior stakeholder leadership to drive alignment around participant health, marketplace liquidity, unit economics, and long-term supply sustainability


Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis is growing its Digital Insights & Experience (DI&E) consulting capability and is looking for Data Analysts who are curious, analytically minded, and motivated to help organisations make better decisions through data‑driven insight.

DI&E brings together data analytics, insight generation and experience‑informed decision‑making to enable confident transformation in secure and regulated environments. Our Data Analysts work at the intersection of data, technology and business context—helping clients understand performance, identify opportunities, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insight.

We are building a multi‑disciplinary team of people from diverse backgrounds. You might be a data analyst, reporting specialist, BI developer, or an analytically‑minded consultant looking to deepen your technical capability while working in a consulting environment. We welcome adaptable problem‑solvers who want to apply analytics to real‑world challenges and continue to grow their careers.

When it comes to living your life, we want your role at AtkinsRéalis to be a meaningful part of your personal journey. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive team culture where people support, mentor and challenge one another. We succeed together, and our flexible and hybrid working practices are designed to support different priorities and ways of working.

Your role

As a Data Analyst within our Digital Insights & Experience and Secure Government business, you will help clients understand, improve and optimise their performance through data‑driven insight. You will work on a wide variety of analytics and transformation programmes across public and private sector environments, often within secure, regulated or complex organisational contexts. Opportunities may include overseas working where appropriate.

AtkinsRéalis provides significant investment in training and development. We want to help you grow as a data professional, strengthen your consulting capability, and build a sustainable and rewarding career.

The Role As a Data Analyst Will Involve


Working alongside AtkinsRéalis Technical Directors, Principals and multi‑disciplinary delivery teams to design and deliver data analytics and visualisation solutions for our clients.
Working with clients to integrate data analytics best practices into their processes and decision‑making.
Working with stakeholders to identify, define and deliver self‑service analytics solutions, dashboards and actionable reports that support decision‑making.
Handling, merging, cleaning and transforming multi‑source data to enable robust analysis and insight generation.
Effectively applying statistical investigation, data analysis and visualisation techniques to bring business problems to life and clearly communicate the 'so what' in data.
Designing and implementing intuitive, consistent and user‑focused data visualisations across environments and formats.
Working in agile delivery environments, including requirements gathering, user stories, prototyping, demonstrations and iterative feedback with end users.
Working on projects end‑to‑end, from requirements definition through implementation, testing, documentation, end‑user training and handover to client teams.
Collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders across a range of experience and seniority levels.
Contributing to decision‑making that supports successful project delivery and measurable client outcomes.
Working with peers to develop new analytics capabilities, solutions and methodologies to deliver to clients.
Communicating and 'selling' analytical insight and solutions to peers and clients to drive understanding and adoption.
Supporting the development of junior colleagues through mentoring and being open to line management responsibilities where appropriate.
Continuously developing your data analysis and visualisation skills through formal training, mentoring and hands‑on delivery experience.
Participating in external and internal activities related to your specialism, including client engagement, conferences, research and thought leadership.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Strategic Finance
Description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM


~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation


The Opportunity

Relay's network is scaling fast. The decisions that shape that growth, where to expand, how to price, where to invest, are made by a finance team that runs on data: driver-level metrics, profitability models, pricing structures, and operational KPIs. This role exists to own the analytics layer that powers those decisions.

As a Senior Data Analyst in the finance squad, you are responsible for how finance sees the business. You own the dashboards and reporting that give visibility into the metrics that matter: cost per parcel, expansion profitability, client and cohort performance, pricing dynamics, and the drivers underneath them. You translate raw operational data into views that finance can use to forecast, model, and act.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the finance squad, but report into the centralised data team. You will work closely with the Senior Data Scientist in the squad, building the reporting and visibility layer on top of their simulation models. You will also work across squads, pulling the metrics they commit to the semantic layer and shaping them into the views finance needs.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?


You take ownership of your domain. You don't wait to be told what finance needs or when something is broken. You're proactive about understanding the questions they're trying to answer and making sure the data is there to answer them.
You're an excellent data analyst who builds clean, reliable reporting that people actually use. You care about data quality, clarity, and making complex metrics understandable.
You're fluent in SQL and experienced with dbt. You can build and maintain well-structured models, not just write queries.
You're comfortable with BI tools and visualisation platforms. You know how to design dashboards that surface the right information without clutter.
You have at least 5 years of experience, ideally with some exposure to finance, FP&A, or commercial analytics. You understand how finance teams think about metrics and drivers.
You communicate clearly with non-technical partners. Finance will rely on your reporting to make decisions. You need to explain what it shows, where the data comes from, and where the limitations are.
You're comfortable working across teams. You'll pull metrics from squads across the business, which means building relationships and understanding how different parts of Relay operate.


Fast and Focused Hiring Process


Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 min
Technical SQL Interview - 1 hours
Hiring Manager Interview - 45 min
Case Study - 1 hour
Values & Impact Interview - 45 min
Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.


Compensation, Benefits & Workplace


Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).


Who Thrives at Relay?

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:

Do you want to use data to shape decisions across the global research communications industry?




Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team




The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.




The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.




As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.




Responsibilities




Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.




Requirements




Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.




Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.




Work in a way that works for you




We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.




Working for you




We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:




Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities




About Us




A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A brief summary




Based within our global Media Services function, this role sits in the Assets & Data team and reports to the Head of Assets & Data. The Data Analyst helps the business make better use of its data, with a particular focus on S&OP, asset management and resource planning across the Group.




Using SQL, Power BI and Excel, the role will turn data from our Group systems into useful reporting and insight. A key part of the role is helping people understand what the data is telling us how our assets are being used, where demand is changing and where there may be opportunities to improve utilisation, reduce cost or make better investment decisions.




What you’ll be responsible for

Write and maintain SQL queries to bring together and prepare data from Group business systems for analysis and reporting.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that help the business understand asset utilisation, demand, availability and performance.
Analyse asset, resource and demand planning data to spot trends, capacity issues, under utilisation and opportunities to improve efficiency or reduce cost.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and teams across the business to understand the questions they are trying to answer and turn these into useful analysis and reporting.
Check and reconcile data before it is used in reporting, investigate anything that does not look right and work with the relevant data owners to resolve issues.
Support good data governance by helping to keep definitions, standards and quality checks consistent across asset and master data.
Keep clear, practical documentation for key reports, dashboards, calculations and recurring analysis so that others can understand how they work and pick them up when needed.
Work with IT where reporting depends on changes to systems, data access or integrations. The role will help define what the business needs from its data, with IT retaining responsibility for system architecture, security, access controls and technical infrastructure.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and business teams to improve the information held in operational systems, including highlighting gaps, inconsistencies or unclear data ownership.
Provide regular and ad hoc analysis to support S&OP, asset planning, investment decisions, business cases and improvement activity across the Group.
Look for sensible ways to make reporting and analysis quicker and easier, including automation and appropriate use of AI tools, while making sure outputs are checked and company data is handled appropriately.

Requirements

Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience, together with at least two years' experience in a data analyst, BI analyst or similar role.
Strong working knowledge of SQL and confidence using it to query, combine and manipulate data.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports, with a good understanding of data modelling, measures and how to present information clearly.
Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and working with larger datasets.
Experience of cleaning and checking data, including dealing with duplicates, missing information and inconsistencies.
A good understanding of databases and data structures, with enough technical knowledge to work confidently with IT and system specialists.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills. You should be interested in what sits behind the numbers and able to explain what the data means, rather than simply producing a report.
Able to work with stakeholders to understand what information they need and explain findings clearly to people who may not be data specialists.
Good attention to detail and a practical approach to keeping reports, calculations and supporting documentation organised and up to date.
Commercially aware, with an interest in how asset utilisation, demand, capacity and investment decisions affect the wider business.
Comfortable using AI and other productivity tools where they are useful, while checking outputs and following company requirements around data security.
Able to manage priorities, work well with colleagues across different teams and countries, and respond calmly when something is time sensitive.
The role supports teams across the Group. From time to time, some flexibility may be needed to




General responsibilities

Play an active part in improving how the team and wider business work. Follow Company policies, information security requirements and the processes and controls relevant to the role. This job description covers the main responsibilities of the role but is not exhaustive and may change as the business and team develop.

We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.

Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.



This role is 5 days per week on-site. Please consider this prior to applying, as we are unable to offer hybrid working for this specific role.





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Global Markets team, where you will play a key role in enabling data-led decision-making across a fast-paced, front-office environment. This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau and exposure to advanced analytics or machine learning is advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time, term-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Nexgen Cloud

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.




We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.




THE ROLE: Data Analyst

NexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.

This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.




What You'll Be Doing

Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:

Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way
Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing
Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits
Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn
Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers
Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company
Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data




About You

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential

Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projects
Strong SQL and Excel skills
Solid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagree
Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build work
A root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it




Nice To Have

Experience with Databricks
Exposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based business
Some experience with financial modelling or FP&A work
Time spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built




What We Offer

Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
Employee wellbeing benefits
25 days holiday, plus public holidays
Private Medical Insurance
Enhanced Pension Scheme
Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
Clear career progression in a high-growth company
A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future




WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.




MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.


We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.


THE ROLE: Data Analyst

NexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.

This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.


What You'll Be Doing

Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way
  • Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing
  • Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits
  • Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn
  • Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers
  • Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company
  • Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data


About You

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential

  • Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projects
  • Strong SQL and Excel skills
  • Solid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagree
  • Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build work
  • A root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it


Nice To Have

  • Experience with Databricks
  • Exposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based business
  • Some experience with financial modelling or FP&A work
  • Time spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future


WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.


MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

You will use multi-system generated data for identification of trends in performance and measurements against agreed KPI’s, and create performance scorecards to aid coaching and development conversations. These will be tailored based on the needs and focusses of each Jurisdiction.

The role also encompasses critical relationship management at all levels (up to Director Level) to articulate service outcomes and root cause analysis to aid Service Improvement strategies.

Be confident in making recommendations and decisions even when they fell difficult or unpopular
Comfortable working in an evolving environment and able to navigate ambiguity with confidence and adaptability.


Essential

Proven experience in influencing senior stakeholders to deliver operational improvements
Performance reporting and tracking

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to use data to shape decisions across the global research communications industry? Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team

The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.

The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.

As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.

Responsibilities


Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.


Requirements


Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.


Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.

Working for you

Benefits

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities


About Us

A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

If performed in NLD Amsterdam (Radarweg), the base pay range is €59,300 - €98,800. This job may be subject to a collective labor agreement in the Netherlands. Please consult with the hiring team for further details.
