Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.


What We Offer

  • ** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
  • 100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
  • Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
  • Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
  • Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
  • A MacBook computer on your first day.
  • 3 weeks vacation.
  • 5 personal days to use at your discretion.
  • A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
  • The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
  • A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.


About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
  • Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
  • Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
  • Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
  • Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
  • Special projects, and other duties as required.


Candidate Qualifications

  • Strong problem solving skills.
  • 2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
  • Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
  • Understanding of statistical principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fully bilingual in English and French.
  • Ability to coordinate across teams.


Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources
Travailler en collaboration avec différents services pour garantir l'exactitude des rapports
Travailler simultanément sur plusieurs initiatives et hiérarchiser les tâches en fonction des livrables à venir

Ce poste exige un grand souci du détail, la capacité à synthétiser des informations et à les présenter sous une forme simple et claire, tant au niveau de la mise en page que de la présentation, tout en sachant les communiquer de manière claire et concise.



Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, finance ou gestion d'entreprise avec une formation en analyse opérationnelle, ou expérience équivalente
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du reporting ou de l'analyse
Excellentes compétences analytiques et de présentation
Solides compétences organisationnelles
Bonnes compétences en gestion du temps et en hiérarchisation des priorités
Orientation client
Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais stricts
Motivation à travailler dans un environnement dynamique
Capacité à travailler aussi bien en équipe qu'en autonomie
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)



Votre expertise technique :

Connaissances avancées de Power BI Desktop et intermédiaires de Power BI Service
Maîtrise approfondie du langage DAX (Data Analytics Expressions)
Expérience en extraction et manipulation de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL, de la fonction « Recherche avancée » de CRM et des rapports Power BI existants
Bonne maîtrise des concepts liés aux bases de données et au stockage de données
Connaissances avancées de la suite Microsoft (Word, Excel et PowerPoint)
La connaissance des systèmes CRM et Finance & Operations (MS Dynamics 365) est un atout



Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler - votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!

Job Overview:

Genetec is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst for its Customer Experience (CX) organization. We are seeking a dynamic and responsive individual who can thrive in a fast-paced and lively environment and transform complex data into actionable insights. 

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). This role requires strong skills in data integration, validation, and interpretation. 



Your day at a glance:

Gather requirements for analysis, reports, and presentations from various stakeholders within the CX organization and translate them into technical specifications
Design and deliver reports, KPIs, and visualizations, ensuring data integrity across multiple sources
Extract, compile, and aggregate data from multiple data sources to be presented in an easy and intuitive format, which will be displayed in reports and presentations
Compile the requirements of recurring reports for their automation in Power BI and assist with their testing once developed
Develop and execute test plans, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve BI reports and dashboards
Collaborate with stakeholders and internal technical teams (e.g., Digital Information) to ensure timely delivery of data models, clear communication, and resolution of blockers
Support the generation of timely and ad-hoc reports based on data from different sources
Work in collaboration with different departments to ensure accuracy of the reports
Work on multiple initiatives at once and prioritize tasks according to the upcoming deliverables

This position requires great attention to detail, the ability to harmonize information and transform it into a simple and easy-to-understand format in terms of both layout and presentation, while also being able to communicate it clearly and concisely. 



What makes you a great fit:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, or Business with an operational analysis background, or equivalent experience  
5+ years of relevant working experience  
3+ years of experience working in reporting or analytics  
Excellent analytical and presentation skills 
Strong organizational skills 
Possess good time management and prioritization skills 
Customer-oriented  
Be able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines  
Motivated to work in a fast-paced environment  
Be able to work in a team environment as well as independently  
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written



Your technical expertise:

 Advanced Power BI Desktop and intermediate Power BI Service knowledge 
Strong proficiency in DAX (Data Analytics Expressions) 
Experience with data extraction and manipulation with the use of SQL queries, CRM Advanced Find, and existing Power BI reports 
Familiar with database and data warehousing concepts 
Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) 
Knowledge of CRM and Finance & Operations systems (MS Dynamics 365) is an asset 



Let's talk perks!

Attractive compensation package
Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule
Subsidized meals in our amazing Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Free, unlimited coffee and fruits
Private, free parking for all employees
Onsite fitness facility with personal trainer, and multiple wellness and health workshops



If you'd like to see what the work environment at Genetec looks like, check out our corporate video: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA



We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!



Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.

Description:
Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our analytics team and help deliver data-driven insights across product performance, customer onboarding, operational efficiency, and business reporting.

In this role, you will work with large datasets, build and maintain reports and dashboards, analyze business trends, and provide leadership teams with accurate, actionable insights. You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

Location: You will be based in our Etobicoke office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.

Reporting Relationship: You will report to the Manager, Analytics – Product & Operations.

Posting Type: Replacement.

Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $71,000 - $100,000.

Your Moneris Career - What You'll Do


Build, maintain, and enhance recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical outputs used by business and leadership teams.

Translate business questions into clear analysis, insights, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support recurring reporting cycles, leadership updates, performance reviews, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish metric definitions, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.
Identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to automate and improve reporting processes.
Maintain documentation for key reports, dashboards, data sources, metrics, assumptions, and business rules.
Contribute to analytics modernization initiatives, including dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, data model improvements, and migration to modern data platforms.


Your Moneris Career - What You Bring

Required skills and experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
3–5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Operations Analyst, or similar role.
Experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, or recurring business performance reporting.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data preparation, and structured analysis.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and business implications.


Experience That Would Set You Apart


Experience in payments, financial services, technology, product analytics, operations analytics, or customer experience analytics.
Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.

At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.


Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Employment Status: Full-time – Permanent

Location: Edmonton, Edmonton Research Park Facility

Work Model: Hybrid




About The Opportunity

The Senior Data Analyst is an opportunity to be part of a professional, purpose-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. Most importantly, your work will contribute to meaningful outcomes that make a difference for Albertans and help shape the future of our province.




Key responsibilities in the role of Senior Data Analyst include:

Data Analysis & Advanced Analytics

Design and execute analytical studies to answer complex business questions, drawing on data from across the enterprise data platform.
Write optimized T-SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across lakehouse, warehouse, and source system environments in Microsoft Fabric.
Use Python (pandas, NumPy, matplotlib/seaborn, scikit-learn) for advanced analytics, statistical modelling, automation of repetitive analytical tasks, and data wrangling at scale.
Build forecasting models, trend analyses, and scenario-based projections to support organizational planning and decision-making.
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations presented in language accessible to non-technical stakeholders.
Document all analytical methodologies, data sources, assumptions, and findings to ensure reproducibility, peer review readiness, and audit compliance.

Data Pipeline & Integration Development

Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Fabric notebooks) following the approved medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold).
Ingest data from enterprise source systems (business applications, APIs, flat files, databases) into Fabric lakehouses using approved ingestion patterns and onboarding criteria.
Write Python and PySpark scripts for data transformation, cleansing, enrichment, and validation within Fabric and Azure environments.
Ensure pipelines are reliable, monitored, and aligned to established error handling, alerting, lineage documentation, and data quality standards.
Collaborate with source system owners and IT teams to clarify integration requirements, resolve upstream data issues, and document data contracts.
Support and maintain existing data integration frameworks; proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, or maintainability.

Reporting, Dashboards & Data Products

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, paginated reports, and semantic models aligned with organizational KPIs, program reporting, and executive decision-making needs.
Apply dimensional data modeling best practices (star schema, conformed dimensions, DAX measures) to build performant, reusable, and trusted semantic models.
Partner with business units to gather reporting requirements, validate metric definitions, and ensure outputs directly address real business decisions.
Ensure all data products leverage certified Gold-tier datasets from the Data Catalogue and comply with data governance and access control standards.
Publish and maintain certified Power BI datasets to support governed self-service reporting for business users across the organization.
Implement and maintain row-level security on reports and semantic models to ensure appropriate, role-based data access for reporting consumers.

Data Quality & Governance

Apply data quality standards throughout the analytics lifecycle from source ingestion to published data products including completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness checks.
Proactively identify, document, and escalate data quality issues; implement remediation in coordination with source system owners and the Data Governance Manager.
Maintain clear data lineage documentation for all analytics pipelines and data products to support traceability and impact analysis.
Contribute to the organizational Data Catalogue by documenting datasets, metric definitions, business glossary terms, and data dictionaries.
Ensure all analytical processes and data products adhere to organizational data governance policies, privacy requirements, and security standards.

Stakeholder Engagement & Data Enablement

Serve as a trusted data advisor to assigned business units translating complex data into plain-language insights and guiding stakeholders toward evidence-based decisions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (program areas, Finance, HR, IT) to understand evolving data needs and translate them into analytical project briefs.
Provide informal guidance and mentorship to intermediate analysts and business developers on SQL, Python, Power BI, and data modeling best practices.
Participate in data working groups, cross-functional projects, and platform planning discussions as a data subject matter expert.
Develop and deliver data literacy resources, how-to documentation, and workshop content to build self-service analytical capability across the organization.




What You Need to Thrive in This Role

Post-secondary diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
5 years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or data engineering roles, with demonstrated Senior-level contribution.
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and BI reports in a professional Microsoft environment.
Experience working in a public sector, quasi-government, non-profit, or complex multi-stakeholder environment is an asset.
Experience with agile delivery practices and cross-functional collaboration in a technical team setting. [Relevant experience or demonstrated knowledge and capability]
In-depth knowledge of SQL (T-SQL) including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query optimization, and stored procedures.
Solid working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation: pandas, NumPy, matplotlib/seaborn, and scikit-learn (or equivalent ML libraries).
Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric: lakehouses, OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Fabric notebooks, and deployment pipelines.
Strong knowledge of Power BI: report authoring, semantic model design, DAX measures, Power Query (M), and row-level security.
Understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold), dimensional data modeling, and data warehouse design patterns.
Knowledge of data governance principles: data lineage, data cataloging, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
Familiarity with Azure data services (Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob / ADLS Gen2) and cloud data platform concepts.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly and persuasively to non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership, in plain language.
Strong planning and priority management skills manages multiple concurrent analytical projects and business unit relationships without compromise.
Intellectually curious stays current with evolving data and analytics tools, platforms, and best practices; applies new knowledge proactively.




Who We Are

Alberta Innovates is the province’s most comprehensive research and innovation agency. From funding to commercialization, we are Alberta’s innovation engine. We foster and accelerate research and innovation to support entrepreneurs and drive economic growth for the benefit of Albertans.




What We Offer

At Alberta Innovates, we believe our people are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your career growth, wellbeing, and work-life balance.

Competitive compensation aligned with our internal career framework and pay structures
Comprehensive health, dental, and pension benefits to support you and your family
Professional development and learning opportunities to help you grow and advance your career
A collaborative and inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and every contribution matters
Flexible work arrangements, where operationally appropriate, along with vacation and earned time off to rest, recharge and help you bring your best self to work.

The minimum starting salary for this position is $88,600 annually. Placement within the salary range will be based on the successful candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and internal equity.




How to Apply

Interested and qualified applicants are encouraged to submit their resume and cover letter prior to the application deadline of October 16, 2026.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo a security clearance and provide credible references.

Additional Information

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
What the Role Does

Turn data into better product decisions.

As a Business Data Analyst, you will partner with Product Owners to design experiments, analyze customer behaviour, and turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Your work will influence product roadmaps across key customer journeys, including conversion, engagement, and renewals.

You will go beyond reporting results. You will apply statistical rigour, investigate unexpected findings, challenge assumptions constructively, and uncover opportunities that improve the customer experience and business performance. This role is for a curious, proactive analyst who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of analytical initiatives, and turns insights into meaningful action to uncover opportunities and strengthen how we measure, report, and make decisions across the business.

This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office.




What You’ll Do

Collaborate with Product Owners to design and plan experiments, define requirements, assumptions, and limitations
Explore and analyze experiment data to understand customer behaviour, usage patterns, and performance drivers
Lead multiple analytical initiatives, using findings to recommend clear next steps and inform priorities
Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover customer behaviour trends, friction points, and growth opportunities
Use AI tools to research internal documentation and tools, support SQL and code development, and review analytical work efficiently
Build dashboards and automated reports to improve accessibility and insight quality
Translate business questions into measurable metrics
Deliver data based recommendations and clearly identify actionable next steps
Improve tracking plans, event quality, and attribution logic to ensure accurate and reliable measurement
Write and optimize SQL queries and notebooks to support analysis
Communicate data analysis results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders
Collaborate with fellow analysts to review results, refine methodologies, and strengthen analytical approaches

What You Bring

Post-secondary education in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or other related programs
3+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or data science
Strong statistical judgment, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power considerations, and the ability to distinguish meaningful findings from noise
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex analysis clearly
Solid understanding of statistics and experiment analysis
Proficiency in SQL, including writing efficient queries with joins, aggregations, and filtering logic
Knowledge of data mining and segmentation techniques
Familiarity with Python for data analysis and visualization (ex. pandas, Matplotlib)
Ability to manage multiple experiments and analyses simultaneously
Proficiency using Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Visualizations, Formulas)
Ability to work independently and manage complex projects
Strong interest in data analysis and a natural tendency to dig deeper into unexpected results
Experience using AI-enabled development environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Copilot

What Sets You Apart

Experience analyzing and designing A/B experiments
Ability to structure ambiguous problems into analytical plans
Confidence challenging assumptions while maintaining strong working relationships
Proactive mindset that goes beyond answering questions to identifying new opportunities
Comfortable presenting insights to Product Owners and leadership

Why You Should Join the LawDepot Team

Excellent total compensation package
Comprehensive health and dental benefits, plus an additional Health Care Spending / Personal Spending Account
Great work life balance (37.5 hour work weeks, flexible schedules, ability to bank hours)
Three weeks paid vacation, plus bonus personal days
Continuous learning opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and training budgets
Company share plan
Free catered lunches for the entire office
Monthly social events for team members to enjoy (think axe throwing, rock climbing, board games, food trucks, trivia contests, and charitable activities)
Work alongside talented, driven colleagues in a culture focused on quality, reliability, innovation, and growth
Personal offices for focused work and to have your individual space (plus collaborative workspaces for when you want to meet with the team)
Free and easily accessible parking
Southgate Mall, Whyte Ave, and Calgary Trail restaurants are only minutes away
Hybrid working arrangements for that balance between getting work done at home and engaging with others in the office

Who We Are

Join one of the fastest growing companies in Canada! LawDepot is proud to be a seven-time Growth 500 ranked organization and a major player in the Global legal solutions industry. Our mission is to modernize the legal document creation experience by empowering people with fast, easy-to-use, and professional solutions. With over ten million satisfied customers worldwide, over two million monthly website visitors, and billions of dollars saved on legal fees, you will be joining a team that is truly making a difference. At LawDepot, we foster a collaborative and inclusive learning culture that values excellence. Apply today and become a part of our exciting journey!




How to Apply

Apply for this job here or submit your application through our Careers page at https://www.lawdepot.ca/career.

We thank all applicants; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Senior Analyst
Description:
Your Opportunity:

Are you passionate about using advanced data analysis techniques to support improved patient access and outcomes? This position will develop analytic solutions that leverage advanced techniques to inform priorities defined in collaboration with Surgical Care Albera (SCA in Acute Care Alberta). The priority areas of focus for this role will include Endoscopy care including within context of the new Dual Practice Program (DPP) model, both province-wide in scope and established as priorities by the Government of Alberta. The data environment in use includes Alberta's Electronic Health Record (Connect Care), inclusive of endoscopy and surgery content and appointment details, combined with other significant databases and acquired data where needed, all within a Snowflake Cloud environment. The Senior Analyst reports to the Program Director, Provincial Surgery Data and Analytics, in support of SCA, clinical quality and accountability standards, and with an emphasis on Operations. They will champion measurement for Program Support, Performance, Quality, and Outcomes Improvement (OI). In addition, the incumbent works alongside PSDA team members supporting the broader surgery and anesthesia domains in a collaborative and coordinated approach and provides expertise to support and guide the team in the specialty area of Endoscopy.

Description:

The Senior Analyst will have or develop strong expertise and understanding of the Connect Care Electronic Health Record data structures and workflows, and in Epic's Clarity database. The Senior Analyst will capture, analyze, interpret and report using existing data assets (which may include legacy and other systems beyond Connect Care), and expand those as well as create new data assets. They will possess strong organizational skills and importantly, be confident in presenting complex information to stakeholders whose analytic experience could range from minimal to extensive, and tailoring their communication to meet the decision maker's needs. o be successful in this role, they will be able to establish, cultivate, and sustain relationships with clinical, analytic, administrative, executive, and academic partners across the provincial health organizations. This in addition to the strong partnerships and collaboration within the PSDA team which will directly contribute to overall data product development and team growth. The expertise required for this role will include advanced analytical and visualization methods in combination with strengths in managing projects/initiatives, strategic planning, working with end users, synthesizing analytical best practices and innovation, developing and advising on impactful reporting approaches, and contributing written materials (presentations, reports, interpretations).

Required Qualifications:

5-8 years experience in the following areas: Working with tables/spreadsheets, databases and tools for querying, integrating, analyzing, interpreting, reporting and disseminating data. Ability to clean and preprocess data to remove inconsistencies and errors, including data transformation, data normalization, and data aggregation. A solid understanding of statistical analysis and be able to use statistical techniques to analyze data. Managing multiple concurrent projects and meeting deadlines. Proficiency in Tableau or other visualization tools.

Additional Required Qualifications:

Proficiency in data platform and transformation (ETL) tools. Experience in Python, and in python libraries. Experience with Snowflake or other cloud databases. Proficiency in Epic Clarity and/or other Cogito tools. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in teams, including mentoring and collaborating with others. Proficiency in English, with excellent communication skills and ability to interact with clients by presenting complex analyses, methods and findings in business- and user-friendly language. Comprehensive understanding of health systems. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio and Access) and the ability to become proficient with new software packages. Must abide by the highest standards of confidentiality and have a sound understanding of the principles within Alberta’s Access to Information Act, as well as the Health Information Act.

Familiarity with Endoscopy clinical workflow and analytics as well as experience with Quality Improvement/Outcomes Improvement methods and a clear understanding of the connection and interdependency between successful quality improvement and measurement will be valuable assets. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Company: The Canadian Centre of Recovery Excellence (CoRE)
Description:
The Canadian Centre of Recovery Excellence (CoRE) is a trailblazing Crown corporation backed by the Government of Alberta, dedicated to transforming the recovery journey for individuals facing mental illness and addiction. By providing decision-makers with cutting-edge data, evidence, and actionable insights, CoRE paves the way for impactful recovery solutions.




Through groundbreaking research, world-class data and analytics, expert guidance, and strong collaborations, CoRE is driving meaningful change at every level of the system. With an unwavering commitment to real-world results, CoRE is not just supporting recovery — it’s shaping a brighter future for all Albertans.




As a trusted advisor to governments, healthcare professionals, and global leaders, CoRE empowers communities to deliver recovery-focused mental health and addiction services that truly make a difference. 




Position Summary

The Senior Data Analyst applies specialized knowledge and skills to support CoRE’s system-level research and evaluation projects through data management, analysis, visualization, and reporting. This includes data extraction, linkage, cleaning, transformation, validation, and preparation of datasets for research and evaluation activities. The role analyzes and visualizes data to identify trends, patterns, performance measurements, and outcomes across the mental health and addiction system, helping to inform evidence-based decision-making.




The Senior Data Analyst uses data management tools, statistical techniques, and business intelligence platforms to prepare datasets, generate insights, and develop dashboards, visualizations, and reports for a variety of audiences. The role presents and explains findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership, and works collaboratively with project teams to integrate data requirements, reporting, and analytical activities into project plans and timelines.




Responsibilities:

1. Data Analytics and Visualization

Plan and complete various analytics using data generated from both secondary and primary data sources across the mental health and addiction system (e.g., descriptive statistics, sampling, power analysis, randomization, regression modelling, psychometrics).
Manage data processing activities for research and evaluation projects, including data extraction, integration, linkage, transformation, cleaning, and preparation for statistical analysis.
Collaborate with research, evaluation, and operational teams to understand information needs, prepare analytical datasets, and support project deliverables.
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders, including health informatics and research partners, to facilitate data access, reporting, and information-sharing activities.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, data visualizations, and reporting products that communicate findings and key performance indicators to diverse audiences.
Create charts, graphics, and visual reporting materials for reports, presentations, and knowledge translation products.




2. Data Practice and Governance

Establish and maintain data quality processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of research and evaluation data.
Follow and promote privacy, confidentiality, and security protocols/procedures in clinical and non-clinical settings.
Identify gaps and opportunities to improve data sources, data quality, reporting processes, and data management practices, and provide recommendations for enhancement
Provide inputs to the identification of opportunities to upgrade supported statistical and analytical models.
Provide guidance and training to project teams to enhance their understanding of how various statistics and analytics can shape project objectives and outcomes. 
Maintain research and evaluation datasets, documentation, and participant electronic records in accordance with data governance, privacy, and security requirements.




3. Research and Evaluation Support

Support research and evaluation projects by providing data expertise throughout project design, data collection planning, and analytical plan development.
Prepare, manage, and document datasets, scripts, technical notes, decision logs, and references.
Contribute to manuscript drafting.
Contribute to evaluation planning, performance measurement, information synthesis, and report development.




4. Project Coordination and Delivery Support

Coordinate and oversee data entry and document management activities to ensure quality and accuracy.
Identifying changes to project plans and raising awareness to research leads to confirming and approving action from research leads.
Monitor project activities to ensure compliance with privacy, confidentiality, and security requirements.
Contribute to communication of research findings in clear language adjusted to the audience with guidance
Support grant proposal, ethics submission, report, and manuscript preparation with guidance from research leads.




5. CoRE Priorities Advancement

Respond to ad-hoc requests for data, reporting, and information requests from internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current on data management, reporting, visualization, and research best practices.
Participate in organizational initiatives, professional development, and other duties as assigned.




Education and Experience:

Master’s degree in related fields (e.g., biostatistics/statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, computational psychology or related quantitative fields) with at least three years of full-time quantitative analyses experience (ideally in a health setting).
A combination of experience and education may be considered as an equivalency on a one-for-one basis.
Experience in data analytics, visualization and relational databases.
Experience working with large, complex, and/or administrative datasets
Minimum 2 years of hand-on experience with analytical models using data visualization tools such as Power BI (preferred) or Tableau.
At least two years’ experience working with large data databases (e.g., SQL, Oracle, Snowflake).




Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

In-depth knowledge and acumen in various quantitative and statistical methods and techniques.
Knowledge of program evaluation analysis methods (e.g., difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, regression, censored data, longitudinal analysis, predictive modeling).
Proficient in data processing skills including data extraction, transformation, linkage, and cleaning.
Proficient with the use of programming languages such as Python or SQL.
Proficient with common statistical tools such as R or SAS
Ability to identify stakeholder and project requirements and translate them into meaningful data products and insights.
Advanced computer skills including MS Office.
Data assurance skills to identify gaps or errors in data prior to analyses.
Effective communication skills to translate complex analyses and analytics processes to lay terms.
Creative ability to create visualizations and summaries of complex data and results for diverse stakeholders.
Commitment to the principles of robust and valid research analyses and related data integrity and management in line with required privacy and security legislation.
Ability to shift priorities as demands or directions change.
Ability to exercise judgment and creative problem-solving when evaluating complex situations with multi-faceted criteria.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize assignments, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records, and ensure quality.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships, share expertise, and coordinate with stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
Knowledge of and ability to apply project management skills.
Understands and can work within given constraints such as technology, policy, regulatory, financial, legal, ethical, social, user constraints.
Ability to synthesize data from multiple sources to inform the development of new products and analytics or revisions to the existing suite.




Preferred:

Familiarity with Alberta administrative data sets (e.g. DAD, NACRS, Practitioner Claims, JOIN, ORCA etc.) and social service systems is a strong asset.
Experience with health or social services data (e.g. inpatient, emergency, pharmacy, mental health, pharmacoepidemiology).
Experience in qualitative and mixed method analysis.




Pension and Benefits

CoRE offers a pension plan with LAPP which provides a retirement income, survivor benefits, and early retirement options. Explore more at www.lapp.ca.
As part of our commitment to our employees’ well-being, CoRE is pleased to provide a group benefits plan and health spending account. This comprehensive plan includes extended health care coverage, travel insurance, dental care, specialized medical coverage, and more. 




Pre-employment Conditions

Prior to an offer of employment, candidates are required to complete and maintain satisfactory Criminal Record, Education Verification, and Canadian Work Authorization checks as well as Conflict of Interest disclosure, as applicable. 
Candidates who have completed post-secondary studies outside of Canada may be required to provide an evaluation of their credentials from the International Qualifications Assessment Service (IQAS) or from a recognized Canadian Credential Evaluator; please visit the Alliance of Credential Evaluation Services of Canada for more information.




Please note: We appreciate the interest of all applicants; however, only those selected to move forward in the recruitment process will be contacted.




Closing Date: October 23, 2026

Thank you for your interest in joining CoRE. We carefully review every application to assess how each candidate's skills and experience align with the requirements of the role. This posting may close before the stated closing date if a sufficient number of applications are received.




If you require accommodation during any portion of the selection process, please let our team know at hr@recoveryexcellence.org

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.

Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.
