Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?


Support analytical work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations to solve business problems. Be the analytical resource for the RA&S marketing teams
Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.
Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
scalability, and team capacity.
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities


What will you need to succeed?


5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda
Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
Ability to document work
BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)


What will be nice to have?


Experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience working with unstructured data


Unique Requirements:


This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, reporting directly into our Head of Data and Insights.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst who wants to do more than answer questions with data. You’ll sit at the heart of our Sports business, partnering with teams across Product, Commercial, Marketing and SEO to uncover opportunities, challenge thinking and influence the decisions that drive performance.

You’ll be joining at an exciting point of transformation. With new products, evolving business models and a growing ambition for how we use data across Sports, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next phase of our analytics capability and how data is used to drive decision-making across the business.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact


Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.
Redesign and enhance our Tableau dashboard suite, providing stakeholders with faster, more actionable performance insights.
Improve the quality and accessibility of data by identifying gaps, optimising reporting and partnering with Data Engineering to strengthen data pipelines.
Apply statistical analysis, behavioural analytics and experimentation to uncover opportunities that drive revenue, conversion and long-term business growth.
Mentor team members while proactively identifying future analytical opportunities that help mature our Performance & Insights function.


What You'll Bring


Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.


The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

3rd: Take home task - you will be given a task to complete and return to us for assessment

4th: Final interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Sports Stakeholder (1 hour video via Zoom)

Why Legend?


Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!


Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of benefits and perks, as outlined in our global offerings above. For country specific benefits please reach out to your talent partner.

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on  [email protected] , and we'll do all we can to support you.

Title: Data Analyst, Power BI
Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.


Profile/Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.


Interpersonal Skills


Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment
Strong technical communication skills.


SYSTRA Canada is committed to having a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that values applications from all and offers employment equity based on the merits and abilities of candidates and personnel.

Note: In this description, the masculine gender is used for easy reading purposes and includes the feminine.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Auth0)
Description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Data Enablement Team

Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers.  We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

Within the Data organization, the Data Enablement team is chartered with creating scalable semantic models that make it safe for anyone to see and understand data. By partnering with product and engineering leaders, this team owns the data lifecycle from strategy to prototyping to implementation, executive dashboard and product level self-service support.

The Senior Data Analyst Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Data Enablement - this role will be responsible for unlocking analytics across the company. You will do this through a combination of data lifecycle ownership, data tooling enablement and outreach programs designed to foster the safe usage of scalable data models for reporting and analytic consumption.

You'll serve as a critical data and technical partner that empowers our Sales, TAM, and Customer Success teams with the deep product insights they need to succeed. An average week will find you partnering with these teams to understand their measurement needs, reviewing engineering plans to ensure we capture critical data signals from the Auth0 product and developing data products that drive key success metrics. You will have multiple tools and teams at your disposal to achieve the core outcome of creating product and customer insights that help our partners drive value and long-term customer success.

What you’ll be doing 

Partner with peers and leaders in Sales, TAM, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Program Management to develop scalable measurement strategies for our data assets, products and services
Drive scalable, semantic data models that can support stakeholders both inside of Auth0 and across the enterprise
Educate and enlighten data stakeholders with newly available objects and models that will unlock product, revenue, sales and business insights
Build reusable data models that support key concepts of the business (Entitlement, Activation, Utilization, Engagement, etc.)
Deliver executive dashboards and product insights based on foundational productionalized data models
Partner with other analysts to create composite measures and insights that span Auth0 and the enterprise
Ensure that data privacy and governance is a first priority at all stages of the data lifecycle

 

What you’ll bring to the role

5+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or analytics engineering, or product management
5+ years of hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Streamlit, PowerBI, Sigma, Omni, etc.)
5+ years of SQL experience
Strong understanding of data lifecycle management including instrumentation, governance, modeling and self-service interfaces
Experience working within a Jira/Agile environment to manage and prioritize technical work.
Build relationships with partners and stakeholders to understand product data needs, distill business requirements into technical documentation and prioritize work accordingly
Excellent business acumen and emotional intelligence in ambiguous environments
BA or higher, preferred; additional relevant work experience in lieu of a degree is acceptable

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!    

Cloud based data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.)
Data engineering (Python, dbt, Kafka, Parquet, DuckDB, etc.)
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and the Pull Request process.
Proficiency with advanced data skills/code, such as working with Claude code or other LLM-based data analysis tools.
Paywall, subscription or authentication based products

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Highlights of the job

We are hiring a Data Analyst [fu ll-time, permanent ] position in Energy Services. We are accepting applications from internal and external candidate s . EPCOR employees are encouraged to apply using their '@epcor.com' email address to ensure their internal seniority is appropriately considered

T he Data Analyst, is accountable for overseeing the implementation of workforce planning processes including maintaining the short-term staff planning (1 to 12 months) to ensure key performance metrics for all stakeholders (Canada and USA) are met. You’ll be responsible for completing statistical dashboards for all stakeholder groups (Canada and USA), ensuring the understanding of the data which supports coaching to improvements. You’ll be required to apply operational knowledge to analyze the relevant data and develop recommendations/provide business insights for management ’s consideration related to workforce planning, operations management, and strategy development.

As a Data Analyst you’ll research and analyze external business factors, together with the relevant work force data from workforce management systems, analyze and examine statistical trends to ensure that stakeholders (Canada and USA) operate in the most effective and efficient manner possible.

What you’d be responsible for

Responsibilities

As a Data Analyst , you’ll report to the Manager, Business Analytics with key responsibilities that include (but not limited to ):


Provid ing input to Canada and US Call Center plans and directions, ensure an appropriate understanding of strategies, ensuring on-going effective and appropriate relationships between other positions with applicable stakeholders
Ensur ing the delivery of optimal results against appropriate performance metrics with k ey measures that will focus on operational effectiveness and efficiency outcomes such as budget, productivity and reliability, and continuous improvement.
Analyz ing and evaluat ing current Canada and USA call center trends, providing recommendations on enhancements for the deployment of workload and/or resources. This includes gathering relevant industry benchmarks to allow for meaningful comparison and making actionable recommendations to leadership for implementation .
Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to identify business needs, prioritize analytical requests, and deliver insights that support operational decision-making .
Ensuring data, reporting, and analytical outputs align with established policies, standards, and governance requirements .
Represent ing Customer Care in projects and initiatives that require analytical experience and knowledge of call center operations
Provid ing adhoc analyses ( as required ) for different groups within Energy Services as well as within EPCOR, including Encor
Creat ing and maintain ing dashboards, reports, and automated products for CAN & US Energy Services (ES) using Power BI, Python, and Microsoft Office tools, following established business requirements and priorities identified by the Business Analytics Manager to support efficiencies and productivity improvements.
Demonstrat ing a high performance, high discipline, safe, accountable, focused, innovative and achievement-oriented, easy to do business with manner of working.


Qualifications

What’s required to be successful


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline .


Experience That Includes


M inimum o f 3 years performing data analysis, reporting, forecasting, or performance measurement in a business environment.
Working with large datasets, databases, and analytical tools to support business decision-making.
Experience in a customer care or utility environment is considered an asset.


Technical Skills


Proficiency in data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and performance measurement.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and data analytics tools such as Power BI, SQL, and Python.
Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support operational and strategic decision-making.


Professional & Interpersonal Skills


Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple teams and levels of the organization.
Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality, and delivering reliable results.
Sound business acumen and the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with stakeholders .


Other Important Facts About This Job

Jurisdiction: CSU52

Class: P1

Hours of work: 80 hours biweekly

Wage: Starting at $4 9.44 per hour (Final Wage and Step will be determined at the time of selection and is based on a combination of factors as outlined in the Collective Agreement.)

EPCOR Employees : Please ensure that you are using your “ @epcor.com ” email address to apply to ensure your internal seniority is appropriately considered

Learn more about Working at EPCOR !

Follow us on LinkedIn , X , Glassdoor or Facebook !

A requirement of working for EPCOR is that you are at least 18 years of age, successfully attained a high school diploma (GED, or equivalent level of secondary education) and legally entitled to work in Canada in a full-time permanent role . (A copy of a valid work permit may be required.)
If you are considered for the position, clearance on all applicable background checks (which may include criminal, identity, educational, and/or credit) and professional reference checks is required. You make recommendations on the planning and execution of operationally and conceptually complex analytical projects and initiatives that involve using your ability to use multiple databases, your analytical skills and your in depth, comprehensive understanding of the line of business and the organization. You serve as a data use specialist advisor and subject matter expert for various stakeholders, and as a resource person and coach for decision-making bodies. Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analyst, Go-To-Market Sales Insights
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to build the tools and analytics that drive revenue for the sales organization behind Lyft's B2B portfolio — a multi-billion-dollar book of business spanning healthcare, business travel, corporate commute, automotive, and transit. This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope
Build and maintain production data pipelines, and automate recurring workflows, with documentation and validation clear enough that a teammate — or an AI agent — can use them without asking you first
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Analyste sénior en intelligence d'affaires
HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment
We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!


🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.

Proven Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation
Expertise in analytics visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI

Demonstrated ability to deliver actionable insights to drive business decisions and facilitate change.
Strong organizational abilities to manage projects and tasks effectively.
Self-motivated individual capable of working independently with minimal supervision while ensuring alignment with team objectives.
Collaborative team player with a proactive and energetic approach
Ability to effectively manage multiple concurrent requests, prioritizing tasks while maintaining accountability to stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and accountability in delivering results to stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills with a track record of presenting insights, analysis, and business opportunities effectively.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on active listening

Build the future with us

Apply now and get ahead in your career, where your talent really belongs!

Title: Analyste Power BI F/H
HTML:
Groupe international d’ingénierie, fortil repose sur un modèle indépendant et rassemble plus de 2 500 collaborateurs. Avec 30 agences réparties dans 14 pays, fortil cultive la liberté d'entreprendre et la libération des potentiels.

Contexte

Dans le cadre du soutien aux activités de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes, l’Analyste Power BI contribue à la collecte, au traitement et à la valorisation des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes d’information. Il accompagne les équipes dans la production d’indicateurs de performance, la reddition de comptes et l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion grâce à des solutions analytiques adaptées.

Responsabilités

  • Supporter les opérations liées à l’information de gestion, notamment en matière de reddition de comptes, de suivi de performance et d’analyse de données pour des projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Collecter, transformer et analyser des données issues de différents systèmes afin de produire des rapports de gestion, des tableaux de bord et des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI);
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord interactifs sous Power BI permettant de faciliter la prise de décision;
  • Effectuer des analyses de données avancées via Excel et des outils spécialisés en intelligence d’affaires;
  • Assurer le suivi et l’analyse des coûts, des échéanciers et de la performance des projets;
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de reporting et proposer des solutions adaptées;
  • Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration des processus, des outils et des systèmes en place afin d’optimiser leur utilisation et renforcer les contrôles associés;
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de gestion de données et des processus de reddition de comptes.

Profil recherché

  • Formation universitaire pertinente en intelligence d’affaires, analyse de données, administration, gestion de projets, informatique ou domaine connexe (Diplôme d’ingénieur requis) ;
  • 10 ans d’expérience dans un rôle d’analyste de données, analyste BI ou analyste en gestion de projets;
  • Solide expérience dans la création de rapports, l’analyse de données et la production de tableaux de bord décisionnels;
  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI (modélisation de données, création de rapports, visualisations et exploitation des données);
  • Très bonne connaissance d’Excel et de la suite Microsoft Office;
  • Connaissance des principes de contrôle de coûts et de suivi budgétaire;
  • Expérience dans des environnements de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Capacité à analyser des données complexes, synthétiser l’information et présenter des recommandations claires aux parties prenantes;
  • Autonomie, rigueur, esprit analytique et bonnes habiletés de communication.

Les raisons de nous rejoindre

Chez fortil, nous mettons en place des leviers concrets pour accompagner votre évolution et garantir un environnement de travail stimulant :

  • L’accompagnement sur la montée en compétences
  • Un écosystème pour sortir de votre zone de confort
  • La possibilité de devenir associé
  • L’engagement dans des projets associatifs
  • Une politique dédiée à la parentalité

Fortil s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap, sans distinction de genre, d’origine ou d’orientation sexuelle.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Company: The Canadian Centre of Recovery Excellence (CoRE)
Description:
The Canadian Centre of Recovery Excellence (CoRE) is a trailblazing Crown corporation backed by the Government of Alberta, dedicated to transforming the recovery journey for individuals facing mental illness and addiction. By providing decision-makers with cutting-edge data, evidence, and actionable insights, CoRE paves the way for impactful recovery solutions.




Through groundbreaking research, world-class data and analytics, expert guidance, and strong collaborations, CoRE is driving meaningful change at every level of the system. With an unwavering commitment to real-world results, CoRE is not just supporting recovery — it’s shaping a brighter future for all Albertans.




As a trusted advisor to governments, healthcare professionals, and global leaders, CoRE empowers communities to deliver recovery-focused mental health and addiction services that truly make a difference. 




Position Summary

The Senior Data Analyst applies specialized knowledge and skills to support CoRE’s system-level research and evaluation projects through data management, analysis, visualization, and reporting. This includes data extraction, linkage, cleaning, transformation, validation, and preparation of datasets for research and evaluation activities. The role analyzes and visualizes data to identify trends, patterns, performance measurements, and outcomes across the mental health and addiction system, helping to inform evidence-based decision-making.




The Senior Data Analyst uses data management tools, statistical techniques, and business intelligence platforms to prepare datasets, generate insights, and develop dashboards, visualizations, and reports for a variety of audiences. The role presents and explains findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership, and works collaboratively with project teams to integrate data requirements, reporting, and analytical activities into project plans and timelines.




Responsibilities:

1. Data Analytics and Visualization

Plan and complete various analytics using data generated from both secondary and primary data sources across the mental health and addiction system (e.g., descriptive statistics, sampling, power analysis, randomization, regression modelling, psychometrics).
Manage data processing activities for research and evaluation projects, including data extraction, integration, linkage, transformation, cleaning, and preparation for statistical analysis.
Collaborate with research, evaluation, and operational teams to understand information needs, prepare analytical datasets, and support project deliverables.
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders, including health informatics and research partners, to facilitate data access, reporting, and information-sharing activities.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, data visualizations, and reporting products that communicate findings and key performance indicators to diverse audiences.
Create charts, graphics, and visual reporting materials for reports, presentations, and knowledge translation products.




2. Data Practice and Governance

Establish and maintain data quality processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of research and evaluation data.
Follow and promote privacy, confidentiality, and security protocols/procedures in clinical and non-clinical settings.
Identify gaps and opportunities to improve data sources, data quality, reporting processes, and data management practices, and provide recommendations for enhancement
Provide inputs to the identification of opportunities to upgrade supported statistical and analytical models.
Provide guidance and training to project teams to enhance their understanding of how various statistics and analytics can shape project objectives and outcomes. 
Maintain research and evaluation datasets, documentation, and participant electronic records in accordance with data governance, privacy, and security requirements.




3. Research and Evaluation Support

Support research and evaluation projects by providing data expertise throughout project design, data collection planning, and analytical plan development.
Prepare, manage, and document datasets, scripts, technical notes, decision logs, and references.
Contribute to manuscript drafting.
Contribute to evaluation planning, performance measurement, information synthesis, and report development.




4. Project Coordination and Delivery Support

Coordinate and oversee data entry and document management activities to ensure quality and accuracy.
Identifying changes to project plans and raising awareness to research leads to confirming and approving action from research leads.
Monitor project activities to ensure compliance with privacy, confidentiality, and security requirements.
Contribute to communication of research findings in clear language adjusted to the audience with guidance
Support grant proposal, ethics submission, report, and manuscript preparation with guidance from research leads.




5. CoRE Priorities Advancement

Respond to ad-hoc requests for data, reporting, and information requests from internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current on data management, reporting, visualization, and research best practices.
Participate in organizational initiatives, professional development, and other duties as assigned.




Education and Experience:

Master’s degree in related fields (e.g., biostatistics/statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, computational psychology or related quantitative fields) with at least three years of full-time quantitative analyses experience (ideally in a health setting).
A combination of experience and education may be considered as an equivalency on a one-for-one basis.
Experience in data analytics, visualization and relational databases.
Experience working with large, complex, and/or administrative datasets
Minimum 2 years of hand-on experience with analytical models using data visualization tools such as Power BI (preferred) or Tableau.
At least two years’ experience working with large data databases (e.g., SQL, Oracle, Snowflake).




Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

In-depth knowledge and acumen in various quantitative and statistical methods and techniques.
Knowledge of program evaluation analysis methods (e.g., difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, regression, censored data, longitudinal analysis, predictive modeling).
Proficient in data processing skills including data extraction, transformation, linkage, and cleaning.
Proficient with the use of programming languages such as Python or SQL.
Proficient with common statistical tools such as R or SAS
Ability to identify stakeholder and project requirements and translate them into meaningful data products and insights.
Advanced computer skills including MS Office.
Data assurance skills to identify gaps or errors in data prior to analyses.
Effective communication skills to translate complex analyses and analytics processes to lay terms.
Creative ability to create visualizations and summaries of complex data and results for diverse stakeholders.
Commitment to the principles of robust and valid research analyses and related data integrity and management in line with required privacy and security legislation.
Ability to shift priorities as demands or directions change.
Ability to exercise judgment and creative problem-solving when evaluating complex situations with multi-faceted criteria.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize assignments, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records, and ensure quality.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships, share expertise, and coordinate with stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
Knowledge of and ability to apply project management skills.
Understands and can work within given constraints such as technology, policy, regulatory, financial, legal, ethical, social, user constraints.
Ability to synthesize data from multiple sources to inform the development of new products and analytics or revisions to the existing suite.




Preferred:

Familiarity with Alberta administrative data sets (e.g. DAD, NACRS, Practitioner Claims, JOIN, ORCA etc.) and social service systems is a strong asset.
Experience with health or social services data (e.g. inpatient, emergency, pharmacy, mental health, pharmacoepidemiology).
Experience in qualitative and mixed method analysis.




Pension and Benefits

CoRE offers a pension plan with LAPP which provides a retirement income, survivor benefits, and early retirement options. Explore more at www.lapp.ca.
As part of our commitment to our employees’ well-being, CoRE is pleased to provide a group benefits plan and health spending account. This comprehensive plan includes extended health care coverage, travel insurance, dental care, specialized medical coverage, and more. 




Pre-employment Conditions

Prior to an offer of employment, candidates are required to complete and maintain satisfactory Criminal Record, Education Verification, and Canadian Work Authorization checks as well as Conflict of Interest disclosure, as applicable. 
Candidates who have completed post-secondary studies outside of Canada may be required to provide an evaluation of their credentials from the International Qualifications Assessment Service (IQAS) or from a recognized Canadian Credential Evaluator; please visit the Alliance of Credential Evaluation Services of Canada for more information.




Please note: We appreciate the interest of all applicants; however, only those selected to move forward in the recruitment process will be contacted.




Closing Date: October 23, 2026

Thank you for your interest in joining CoRE. We carefully review every application to assess how each candidate's skills and experience align with the requirements of the role. This posting may close before the stated closing date if a sufficient number of applications are received.




If you require accommodation during any portion of the selection process, please let our team know at hr@recoveryexcellence.org

Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.

Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.

An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.

A practical, solution-oriented mindset.

Description:

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. We are currently seeking a Data Analyst to join the Data Solutions team in the Wealth Technology group at CI Wealth.
